rpc.analytics.artifacts.description: Permission: global `analytics.read`. Returns ML model artifacts ordered by creation, optionally filtered by model_kind and active_only.

rpc.analytics.create_job.description: Permission: superuser for `kind=train_ml`; for `kind=compute`, workspace `analytics.update` when `workspace_id` is supplied (that workspace must also be verified or trusted) or global `analytics.update` when it is omitted. Creates an analytics job and enqueues it to the worker, returning 202; 409 on an active-job conflict.

rpc.analytics.explain.description: Permission: global `analytics.read`. Returns the most recent explanation row for a player in a tournament (optionally by algorithm_id); 404 if none found.

rpc.analytics.feedback_list.description: Permission: global `analytics.read`. Returns all anomaly-feedback rows recorded for a tournament.

rpc.analytics.feedback_submit.description: Permission: global `analytics.update`. Upserts a reviewer verdict/note for a player anomaly and returns the saved row.

rpc.analytics.get_algorithm.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a single analytics algorithm by id.

rpc.analytics.get_analytics.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns per-team analytics (players, wins/losses, shifts) for a tournament and required algorithm; 404 if the algorithm is missing.

rpc.analytics.get_streaks.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns players' placement streaks across recent tournaments for the given tournament_id.

rpc.analytics.jobs_active.description: Permission: global `analytics.read`. Returns the currently active analytics job for the optional workspace_id, or null if none.

rpc.analytics.jobs_get.description: Permission: global `analytics.read`. Returns a single analytics job by id; 404 if not found.

rpc.analytics.jobs_list.description: Permission: global `analytics.read`. Returns recent analytics jobs (default limit 20), optionally scoped by workspace_id and active_only.

rpc.analytics.list_algorithms.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a paginated list of analytics algorithms, optionally filtered by tournament_id.

rpc.analytics.match_quality.description: Permission: global `analytics.read`. Returns per-encounter match-quality rows for a tournament, optionally filtered by algorithm_id.

rpc.analytics.performance.description: Permission: global `analytics.read`. Returns ML performance rows for a tournament, optionally filtered by algorithm_id.

rpc.analytics.player_anomalies.description: Permission: global `analytics.read`. Returns player-anomaly rows for a tournament, optionally filtered by player_id and kind.

rpc.analytics.points.description: Permission: workspace `analytics.update` when `workspace_id` is supplied (that workspace must also be verified or trusted), else global `analytics.update`. Creates a 202 async compute job scoped to the Points algorithm for the required tournament_id.

rpc.analytics.recalculate.description: Permission: workspace `analytics.update` when `workspace_id` is supplied (that workspace must also be verified or trusted), else global `analytics.update`. Creates a 202 async compute job for a tournament (optionally scoped to given algorithm_ids). Metered as `analytics.recalculate`: the call consumes quota against the caller's workspace/API-key limits and answers 429 `quota_exceeded` with a `Retry-After` header once they are spent.

rpc.analytics.shift.description: Permission: global `analytics.update`. Sets the organizer's manual shift override (`AnalyticsPlayer.shift`) for a player and returns the saved value; 404 if the player has no analytics row.

rpc.analytics.standings.description: Permission: global `analytics.read`. Returns standings-distribution rows for a tournament, optionally filtered by algorithm_id.

rpc.app.active_announcements.description: Permission: public; no authentication required — an optional identity only filters out already-dismissed rows. Returns the currently-published platform-wide announcements for the site banner, newest first. Anonymous callers are welcome and get every global announcement inside its publish/expiry window; for an authenticated viewer the ones already dismissed are filtered out, which is why the route forwards identity when it is present.

rpc.app.admin.delete#workspace.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.delete`. Deletes a workspace via the shared CRUD engine; returns 204, 404 if not found.

rpc.app.admin.update#workspace.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Updates a workspace via the shared CRUD engine, 404 if not found.

rpc.app.admin_user_notification_preferen.description: Permission: global `auth_user.update`. Flips the Discord-DM switches of the account named by the path id — the operator-side twin of the self-service write, with the same partial-merge semantics: an omitted group keeps its stored value, unknown group names are a 422 and so is a `staff_workspaces` key the account is not staff in. The edited row is the target's, never the caller's. Answers with the same full payload as the read, so the screen needs no refetch. 404 when the account does not exist.
rpc.app.admin_user_notification_preferen.summary: Update one account's Discord DM preferences

rpc.app.admin_user_notifications_get.description: Permission: global `auth_user.read`. Everything the account inspector shows about the account named by the path id: the effective Discord-DM group switches and per-workspace staff switches with defaults filled in, whether a Discord account is connected at all, the unread count that account's own bell shows (same audience rules as their inbox, not a platform-wide total) and the ten most recent Discord DMs handed to the bot for them, newest first, each with how far it got (`pending`, `posted`, `failed`, or `lost` when the broker dropped it). Skips are never recorded, so an empty `recent_deliveries` means nothing was sent — it is not a gap in the record. Unlike the self-service preferences read this acts on another account, which the global grant is what authorizes. 404 when the account does not exist.

rpc.app.announcement_create.description: Permission: workspace `announcement.create` in that workspace for a `workspace` announcement, superuser for a `global` one. Publishes an announcement and audits it. A `workspace` one needs at least one locale plus a default_locale among the filled ones; a `global` one renders to every visitor including anonymous ones and requires every supported locale (ru and en) — a workspace grant cannot reach the platform's voice. `user` is not an accepted audience: personal notifications are written by the flows that cause them, from server-resolved recipients. 422 on a locale or audience/workspace_id mismatch.

rpc.app.announcement_delete.description: Permission: decided from the stored audience like the edit — workspace `announcement.delete` for a workspace announcement, superuser for a global one. Expires the announcement as of now and audits it, answering 204. The row is kept rather than deleted: it is a notification row that people already have in their inbox, and the read marks pointing at it must stay meaningful. 404 if the id is not an announcement.

rpc.app.announcement_list.description: Permission: workspace `announcement.read` in `workspace_id`, or superuser for the platform-wide feed (`workspace_id` omitted). Returns one scope's announcements newest first, expired ones included — the operator view exists to show what is scheduled and what has been retired, which the banner's time window hides. The two scopes mirror the writes, so the list can never read announcements the caller could not publish.

schema.description: Page size (default 50, capped at 200).

rpc.app.announcement_update.description: Permission: decided from the STORED audience, never the request — workspace `announcement.update` for a workspace announcement, superuser for a global one. Partially edits the text and expiry of an already-published announcement and audits it. `locales` replaces the whole map when present; audience and workspace_id are immutable. Read marks are deliberately left alone — clearing them would re-show a banner to everyone who already dismissed it, for a corrected typo. 404 if the id is not an announcement.

rpc.app.assets.delete.description: Permission: workspace `asset.delete` in the given workspace, or superuser when no `workspace_id` is given. Deletes an achievements/divisions/catalog asset from S3 by slug prefix; 422 on invalid asset_type, 404 if nothing deleted.

rpc.app.assets.upload.description: Permission: workspace `asset.create` in the given workspace, or superuser when no `workspace_id` is given. Uploads an achievements/divisions/catalog asset to S3, returning its key and public URL; 422 on invalid asset_type.

rpc.app.audit_list.description: Permission: workspace `audit.read` in the requested workspace, or superuser to read every workspace at once. Returns a paginated slice of the platform audit log, newest first (created_at then id, both descending). workspace_id is required for everyone but a superuser and is enforced as a hard scope: entity_type/entity_id and actor_user_id narrow within it and never reach a row outside it. A superuser may omit workspace_id to see every workspace plus the platform-level rows that belong to none.

schema.description: Only rows with created_at >= since.
schema.title: Since

schema.description: Hide rows by this actor; machine rows (NULL actor) are kept.
schema.title: Exclude Actor User Id

schema.description: Comma-separated audit sources to keep, e.g. `admin,api_key,discord,challonge`.
schema.title: Source

rpc.app.catalog.admin_create.description: Permission: superuser only. Creates a catalog entity; slug defaults to the slugified name and must fit 64 characters (422 otherwise); a character's attrs.class must be one of the discipline's classes; a map of a discipline with modes needs its mode as parent_id.

rpc.app.catalog.admin_delete.description: Permission: superuser only. Deletes a catalog entity by id, returns 204; fails while a game, pool or legacy mapping references it.

rpc.app.catalog.admin_list.description: Permission: superuser only. Returns a paginated list of one discipline's catalog entities of one kind (character, map, mode); filters search, parent_id, attrs (JSON containment), active; 404 for a kind the discipline does not declare.

rpc.app.catalog.admin_update.description: Permission: superuser only. Updates a catalog entity by id; attrs is a shallow merge (present keys replace, absent keys keep). Explicit null is refused for name, slug, attrs and active (422); image_path and parent_id can be cleared. Renaming preserves the stored slug; an explicit slug must fit 64 characters.

rpc.app.catalog.get.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns one entity with its parent expanded; inactive rows are readable. 404 `not_found` when the id is not a row of that discipline and kind (never an entity relabelled from another game).

rpc.app.catalog.list.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a paginated list of one discipline's characters, maps or modes (`kind`); `search`, `parent_id`, `attrs` (JSON object) and `active` filter it, active rows only unless `active=false` is passed. 404 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown discipline, 404 `catalog_kind_not_declared` for a kind the game does not declare (League has no `mode`).

rpc.app.catalog.workspace_characters.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.create` or `achievement.update`. Read-only: returns a paginated list of one discipline's catalog characters (same entity shape as the admin catalog list) so an organizer can link an achievement rule to one; catalog mutations stay superuser only; 404 for a missing workspace, 422 for a discipline the workspace does not have enabled.
rpc.app.catalog.workspace_characters.summary: List a discipline's characters for a workspace

rpc.app.catalog_aliases.attach.description: Permission: superuser only. Adds the raw name to the target entity's aliases and closes that entity's discipline/kind miss in one transaction; 404 if the entity is missing. Stat/event/role misses are never attachable (dismiss only).

rpc.app.catalog_aliases.dismiss.description: Permission: superuser only. Marks an alias miss resolved without attaching it; the row reopens if the same name reappears in a log. 404 if the miss is missing.

rpc.app.catalog_aliases.misses_list.description: Permission: superuser only. Returns a paginated queue of names (any discipline) a match log or canonical document used that did not resolve, ordered by occurrences then recency. kind is one of character|map|mode (catalog entity names) or stat|event|role (undeclared codes; a role's raw_name is dimension:role); open misses only unless include_resolved=true.

rpc.app.disciplines.list.description: Permission: public; an optional identity lets a hidden workspace's members read it. Returns the installed disciplines with their kinds, capabilities and, for `workspace_id=<id>`, whether the workspace enabled each (`all` is the global view, every discipline enabled). Order: declaration order for `all`; for a workspace, its enabled disciplines first in its own `disciplines_enabled` order, then the rest in declaration order. 404 for an unknown or hidden-to-viewer workspace, 422 `invalid_workspace_id` otherwise.

schema.description: Workspace id (positive integer) or the literal "all" for the global view

rpc.app.disciplines.metadata.description: Permission: public; an optional identity lets a hidden workspace's members read it. Returns the descriptor, the role dictionary (inactive rows included for history; global roles plus the requested workspace's sub-roles), stat and event vocabularies, team-format presets and the native ladder. 404 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown code; a disabled discipline is still readable.

schema.description: Workspace id (positive integer) or the literal "all" for the global view

rpc.app.matches.log.description: Permission: any authenticated user — the gateway route requires a session and the handler performs no further permission or ownership check. Returns the raw match-log file bytes for a match (base64 from the worker, decoded by the gateway); 404 if the match or log is missing.

rpc.app.notification_admin_list.description: Permission: workspace `notification.read` in the workspace named by `workspace_id`. Returns one page (`page`/`per_page`, with `total`) of the notifications this workspace's own activity produced (`source_workspace_id`), newest first, expired ones included — the operator view exists to show what has already been retired, which the inbox's time window hides. Announcements are not listed here, they have their own CRUD. 422 on an unknown `kind`.

schema.description: One notification kind; omitted lists every kind.
1-based page number (default 1).
Page size (default 25, capped at 100).

rpc.app.notification_admin_list.summary: List the notifications a workspace produced

rpc.app.notification_admin_retire.description: Permission: workspace `notification.delete` in `workspace_id`. Expires the selected rows as of now — taking them out of every recipient's inbox and badge count — and audits the batch once. `ids` and `kind` are filters over the same scoped statement and may be combined; naming neither is a 422 rather than a tenant-wide wipe. The rows and their read marks are kept, like an announcement retire; already-expired rows are skipped, so a repeat call answers 0.

rpc.app.notification_preferences_get.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — the caller's own preferences only. Returns the Discord-DM group switches (`tournament`, `matches`, `team`, `staff`) with the defaults filled in: a group the user never touched is on, so a new group reaches everybody without a backfill. `discord_linked` reports whether the account has a Discord connection at all — the switches deliver nothing without one. `staff_workspaces` lists every workspace where the caller may resolve match results, each with its own effective switch; a staff DM needs both the `staff` group and its workspace's switch on. Empty when the caller is staff nowhere.
rpc.app.notification_preferences_get.summary: Read the caller's Discord DM preferences

rpc.app.notification_preferences_update.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — the caller's own preferences only. The edit is partial: an omitted group keeps its stored value, so one toggle flipped in a stale tab cannot re-assert the other two. Unknown group names are a 422. `staff_workspaces` (`{workspace_id: bool}`) merges the same way; a workspace the caller is not staff in is a 422. Answers with the same effective shape as the read. In-app notifications are not switchable — this only governs delivery to Discord.
rpc.app.notification_preferences_update.summary: Update the caller's Discord DM preferences

rpc.app.notifications_delete.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — the caller's own inbox only. Removes rows from this caller's inbox and returns how many left it together with the refreshed unread count. An omitted or null `ids` targets the whole visible inbox, and `only_read: true` narrows that to rows already marked read (the "clear read" button). The deletion is per viewer: the underlying row survives, so one reader dismissing a platform-wide announcement does not take it out of anybody else's inbox. Ids outside the caller's audience are dropped silently rather than rejected, and a repeat call deletes nothing and is not an error.
rpc.app.notifications_delete.summary: Delete notifications from the caller's inbox

rpc.app.notifications_list.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — the caller's own inbox only. Returns one page of the caller's inbox newest first, plus the unread badge count and an opaque next_cursor (null on the last page). The audience is computed from the authenticated identity alone — personal rows, rows for the workspaces the caller belongs to, and platform-wide announcements — so there is no recipient parameter to pass. Expired and not-yet-published rows are excluded. System kinds carry no text: the row is kind + payload snapshot and the client renders it. 422 on a malformed cursor.

schema.description: Opaque continuation from the previous page's next_cursor.
Page size (default 20, capped server-side).

rpc.app.notifications_mark_read.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — the caller's own inbox only. Inserts read marks for the given ids and returns how many actually landed together with the refreshed unread count. An omitted or null `ids` marks the whole visible inbox (the "mark all read" button). Ids outside the caller's audience are dropped silently rather than rejected, so the endpoint cannot be used to probe whether another user's notification exists; a repeat call marks nothing and is not an error.

rpc.app.quota.operation_upsert.description: Permission: superuser only. Sets one operation's heavy cost and its enabled flag — `enabled=false` is the per-operation kill switch, and it takes effect on the next call rather than at the end of a cache TTL. Audited as `quota.operation_upsert`. A call refused by the daily heavy budget answers 429 `code=rate_limited` with `Retry-After`, naming the dimension (`details.limit_name`, here `heavy_per_day`) and the bucket (`details.scope`), which the gateway relays inside `fields[0]`.
rpc.app.quota.operation_upsert.summary: Create or update a metered operation

rpc.app.quota.operations.description: Permission: superuser only. Returns the `quota.operation` catalogue — the slugs that cost heavy budget, their cost and their enabled flag. A slug with no row here costs no heavy budget; it still spends one per-minute request token. A call refused once that budget is spent answers 429 `code=rate_limited` with `Retry-After`, naming the dimension and the bucket as `details.limit_name` and `details.scope` (relayed by the gateway inside `fields[0]`).

rpc.app.quota.plan_upsert.description: Permission: superuser only. Creates the plan named by `slug` or replaces it, INCLUDING its scope rows wholesale — a plan is read as a complete statement of its tier, so a scope omitted from the body is deleted rather than kept. Audited as `quota.plan_upsert` with the previous and new limit rows; the policy cache is dropped immediately, so the next metered call on every affected workspace enforces the new numbers. A call these limits refuse answers 429 `code=rate_limited` with `Retry-After`, naming the dimension and the bucket as `details.limit_name` and `details.scope` (relayed by the gateway inside `fields[0]`).
rpc.app.quota.plan_upsert.summary: Create or replace a quota plan

rpc.app.quota.plans.description: Permission: superuser only — a plan is a platform-wide tier, not tenant data. Returns every plan with its per-scope limit rows (`workspace`/`key`/`session`); a null dimension means unlimited at that scope. These are the numbers a refusal reports: a metered call over budget answers 429 `code=rate_limited` with `Retry-After`, naming the dimension and the bucket as `details.limit_name` and `details.scope` (relayed by the gateway inside `fields[0]`).

rpc.app.quota.workspace_usage.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` (i.e. a workspace admin) or superuser. Returns the workspace's plan slug and its shared pool's effective ceilings next to what has been spent — requests this minute, heavy units today, concurrent heavy slots held, and the two payload caps — with the seconds until each window resets. Per-key usage is not reported here (identity-service answers for an API key). `policy` is the editable half and covers all three scopes (`workspace`/`key`/`session`), because all three override rows belong to this tenant: each entry carries `override`, the row exactly as stored (all-null when the scope has none), and `inherited`, the ceiling `quota_set` holds a non-superuser write to. 404 if the workspace is missing. A metered call refused against these numbers answers 429 `code=rate_limited` with `Retry-After`, naming the dimension and the bucket as `details.limit_name` and `details.scope` (relayed by the gateway inside `fields[0]`).

rpc.app.users.admin_create.description: Permission: global `user.create`. Creates a player and returns it with discord/battle_tag/twitch identities.

rpc.app.users.admin_delete.description: Permission: global `user.delete`. Deletes a player by id, returns 204.

rpc.app.users.admin_list.description: Permission: global `user.read`, or workspace `user.read` in the workspace named by `workspace_id`. Returns a paginated admin list of players; with `workspace_id` the page is filtered to that workspace's roster.

rpc.app.users.admin_update.description: Permission: global `user.update`. Updates a player by id and returns it with its identities.

rpc.app.users.avatar_delete.description: Permission: global `user.update`. Removes a player's avatar from S3 and clears its URL.

rpc.app.users.avatar_upload.description: Permission: global `user.update`. Uploads a player's avatar to S3 and stores its URL.

rpc.app.users.battletag_add.description: Adds a BattleTag identity to a player; requires the global user.update permission.

rpc.app.users.battletag_delete.description: Removes a player's BattleTag identity by identity id; requires the global user.delete permission, returns 204.

rpc.app.users.battletag_update.description: Updates a player's BattleTag identity by identity id; requires the global user.update permission.

rpc.app.users.by_name.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Resolves a player by BattleTag (name containing '#', dashes normalized) or by Discord name with optional entity expansion.

rpc.app.users.discord_add.description: Adds a Discord identity to a player; requires the global user.update permission.

rpc.app.users.discord_delete.description: Removes a player's Discord identity by identity id; requires the global user.delete permission, returns 204.

rpc.app.users.discord_update.description: Updates a player's Discord identity by identity id; requires the global user.update permission.

rpc.app.users.list.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a paginated, sortable, name-searchable list of players.

rpc.app.users.me_favorite_add.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user with the allow-by-default `account.social` capability; self-service — the caller acts on their own account only. Bookmarks a player for the caller's own account. Idempotent (favoriting an already-favorited player is a no-op), 404s if the player id does not exist.

rpc.app.users.me_favorite_remove.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user with the allow-by-default `account.social` capability; self-service — the caller acts on their own account only. Removes a player from the caller's own favorites, returns 204. Idempotent (unfavoriting a player that isn't favorited is a no-op, not an error).

rpc.app.users.me_favorites_list.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user with the allow-by-default `account.social` capability; self-service — the caller acts on their own account only. Returns the caller's own favorited players (id + name), newest favorite first. Scoped to the caller's auth account, not a linked player, so it works even without one.

rpc.app.users.me_set_stream_visibility.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user with the allow-by-default `account.social` capability; self-service — the caller acts on their own account only. Sets whether the caller's own live stream may be surfaced on tournament pages and returns their updated player. A false value is a veto: it outranks the per-tournament stream-POV opt-in and the Twitch account's public visibility, and takes effect immediately rather than at the next poll tick. Independent of social-account visibility, so the handle stays on the public profile. Requires a linked player (404 otherwise).

rpc.app.users.me_social_list.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user with the allow-by-default `account.social` capability; self-service — the caller acts on their own account only. Returns the caller's own player with its linked social accounts -- which handles are connected, which one is primary, and each account's public-profile visibility. Accounts are added through the identity-service OAuth link flow, never here; a caller with no linked player gets an empty list rather than a 404.

rpc.app.users.me_social_set_primary.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user with the allow-by-default `account.social` capability; self-service — the caller acts on their own account only. Promotes one of the caller's own social accounts to primary -- the handle shown first on their public profile -- and returns the updated player. OAuth-verified accounts only (400 otherwise), because an unverified handle as primary would put an unproven identity on a public profile. Requires a linked player; 404 for an account id the caller does not own.

rpc.app.users.me_social_set_visibility.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user with the allow-by-default `account.social` capability; self-service — the caller acts on their own account only. Sets whether one of the caller's own social accounts is shown to anyone on their public profile, and returns the updated player. Global scope only: this is the self-service hide switch, not the per-workspace admin override, and hiding never deletes the account or its OAuth link. Requires a linked player; 404 for an account id the caller does not own.

rpc.app.users.merge_execute.description: Permission: superuser only. Atomically merges player references, selected social identities, auth ownership, preserved resources and audit after rechecking the locked preview fingerprint. Requires independent confirmations for auth changes, auth deletion and permission/access changes. Both accounts' refresh tokens/API keys are revoked; identity-service session blacklisting and RBAC invalidation must succeed before commit. Password, email, active and superuser flags are never combined.

rpc.app.users.merge_preview.description: Permission: superuser only. Previews merging player profiles, including two auth-linked profiles. auth_policy chooses the surviving auth account, keeping/deleting the other, each OAuth connection destination, and explicit resource-conflict choices. Returns account roles/denies, preservation counts, blockers and a state fingerprint without exposing credentials.

rpc.app.users.search.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns players whose profile name, or a game, Discord or Twitch handle shown on their public profile, matches a free-text query.

rpc.app.users.social_add.description: Permission: superuser only. Adds a social account (provider + username) to a player and returns the refreshed player.

rpc.app.users.social_delete.description: Permission: superuser only. Removes one of a player's social accounts by account id and returns the refreshed player.

rpc.app.users.social_set_primary.description: Permission: superuser only. Promotes one of a player's social accounts to primary and returns the refreshed player.

rpc.app.users.social_set_visibility.description: Permission: global `user.read` for the global switch, or workspace `user.read` in the workspace the payload names — the scope being changed is the scope being authorized. Toggles whether a player's social account is displayed in that scope and returns the refreshed player.

rpc.app.users.social_update.description: Permission: superuser only. Updates the username/url of one of a player's social accounts by account id and returns the refreshed player.

rpc.app.users.social_verify.description: Permission: superuser only. Marks an OAuth-eligible social account verified when the automatic sync missed a real OAuth connection that proves it, and returns the refreshed player.

rpc.app.users.twitch_add.description: Adds a Twitch identity to a player; requires the global user.update permission.

rpc.app.users.twitch_delete.description: Removes a player's Twitch identity by identity id; requires the global user.delete permission, returns 204.

rpc.app.users.twitch_update.description: Updates a player's Twitch identity by identity id; requires the global user.update permission.

rpc.app.workspaces.by_host.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Resolves a request host to its workspace ({workspace_id, slug}) -- the entry point to multitenancy, called by the edge before anything else knows which tenant it is serving. A host in the platform zone matches on subdomain; any other host matches only a VERIFIED custom domain. Fail-closed: a missing, malformed, unknown or not-yet-verified host returns null data rather than an error.

rpc.app.workspaces.by_slug.description: Permission: public; no authentication required -- an optional identity widens what resolves. The community page's lookup: the workspace whose slug is `slug`, with its grids, when `scope=all` of the list would include it for the caller (listed, one of their memberships, or any for a superuser); 404 otherwise, so a hidden or `unverified` workspace never opens to anyone else by its slug.

rpc.app.workspaces.clear_custom_domain.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Removes the custom domain, its verification token, and verified_at; 404 if workspace missing.

rpc.app.workspaces.create.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user holding the allow-by-default global `workspace.self_create` capability. Creates a workspace, provisions system roles, stamps and adds the creator as owner, and busts the RBAC cache. Deny that capability for an account (negative RBAC, global scope) to revoke self-service creation from it (403). Then capped per account by `workspace_creation.max_owned_per_user`, counted over `Workspace.owner_id` (403 `workspace_create_limit_reached`); platform slugs are unclaimable (400 `slug_reserved`), 400 on a duplicate slug, and the new workspace is born `unverified`.

rpc.app.workspaces.discord_guild_clear.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`, deliberately not Discord administration -- so an organiser can leave a server they were kicked from. Clears the workspace's Discord guild claim (guild id, verified_at, verified_by). 404 if workspace missing. Idempotent when nothing is bound.

rpc.app.workspaces.discord_guild_verify.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`, and the caller must additionally administer the Discord guild (owner or MANAGE_GUILD, proven through identity-service). Binds the guild to the workspace, stamping verified_at/verified_by; 404 if workspace missing, 403 `discord_relink_required` when the caller's Discord connection has no usable OAuth token (re-link Discord), 403 `discord_guild_not_administered` if the caller does not administer the guild, 409 if another workspace already claims it, 503 if identity-service is unreachable.
rpc.app.workspaces.discord_guild_verify.summary: Verify and bind a Discord guild

rpc.app.workspaces.get.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a single workspace by id, 404 if not found.

rpc.app.workspaces.icon_delete.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Removes a workspace's icon from S3 and clears its URL; 404 if workspace missing.

rpc.app.workspaces.icon_upload.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Uploads a workspace icon to S3 and stores its URL; 404 if workspace missing.

rpc.app.workspaces.list.description: Permission: public; no authentication required — an optional identity only widens `scope=admin`/`all`. Lists workspaces (unpaginated). `scope=public` (the default) is the home-page directory and is byte-identical for every caller, superusers included: hidden and `unverified` workspaces never appear. `scope=admin` is the management list -- every workspace for a superuser, otherwise only the caller's own memberships at any tier. `scope=all` is that unioned with the public directory (the workspace switcher). Any other value is a 422. Rows carry no `effective_division_grid_versions`: read one workspace for its grids.

rpc.app.workspaces.member_add.description: Permission: workspace `workspace_member.create`. Adds an auth user to a workspace with resolved role ids and busts the member's RBAC cache; 400 if already a member.

rpc.app.workspaces.member_remove.description: Permission: workspace `workspace_member.delete`. Removes a member from a workspace and busts their RBAC cache; refuses to remove the last owner, returns 204.

rpc.app.workspaces.member_update.description: Permission: workspace `workspace_member.update`. Updates a member's workspace roles and busts their RBAC cache; 404 if member missing.

rpc.app.workspaces.members_autofill_role.description: Permission: workspace `workspace_member.update`. Grants the baseline 'player' role to every auth-linked member of the workspace that currently has no role; idempotent, returns the count assigned.

rpc.app.workspaces.members_list.description: Permission: workspace `workspace_member.read`. Paginated, searchable (username/email) list of a workspace's auth-linked members enriched with auth-user info and RBAC roles. `role_id` keeps holders of that role; `exclude_role_id` drops holders of any listed role. 404 if workspace missing.

schema.description: Drop members who hold any of these roles. Repeat the param or comma-separate ids.

rpc.app.workspaces.my_discord_guilds.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — the caller's own Discord guilds only. Returns the Discord guilds the caller owns or can manage (via identity-service, the `guilds` OAuth scope), for picking one to verify, and `relink_required` — true when the caller's Discord connection has no usable OAuth token, so the empty list means "re-link Discord" rather than "administers nothing"; 503 if identity-service is unreachable.

rpc.app.workspaces.notification_config_g.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update` — the stored channel names a private guild. Returns where this workspace's broadcast notifications are posted (`discord_channel_id`, a snowflake as a string), the language they are written in, which kinds are posted (`broadcast_kinds`), and the full set that may be enabled (`broadcastable_kinds`) so the screen needs no second source of truth. A workspace that never saved anything reads as its defaults — no channel, `ru`, registration and check-in openings. 404 if workspace missing.
rpc.app.workspaces.notification_config_g.summary: Read a workspace's notification delivery settings

rpc.app.workspaces.notification_config_u.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Stores the whole form. A non-null `discord_channel_id` must be a text channel of THIS workspace's verified guild — otherwise an administrator of one workspace could make the bot post into another organiser's server: 409 `discord_guild_not_linked` when no guild is bound, 422 `discord_channel_not_in_guild` when the channel is not one of its text channels, and 503 `discord_unavailable` when discord-service cannot be asked (an unchecked channel is never stored). `broadcast_kinds` must be a subset of `broadcastable_kinds` and `locale` one of `ru`/`en`, both 422 otherwise. Returns the same shape as the read. 404 if workspace missing.
rpc.app.workspaces.notification_config_u.summary: Update a workspace's notification delivery settings

rpc.app.workspaces.owner_get.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update` (the public workspace model deliberately publishes no owner). Resolves `Workspace.owner_id` — the account accountable for the workspace and counted against the per-account create cap — to its username, email and avatar; returns null data when no owner is stamped, 404 if workspace missing.

rpc.app.workspaces.owner_set.description: Permission: superuser only — stricter than the `workspace.update` gate on the matching read, because owner_id is what the per-account create cap is counted over. Stamps `Workspace.owner_id` with the given auth account, or clears it when `auth_user_id` is null, and returns the resolved owner. RBAC roles are untouched (the stamp and the `owner` role are decoupled), the per-account cap is not re-checked (a superuser assignment is the override for it), every call is audited including a no-op, 404 if the workspace or the target account is missing.
rpc.app.workspaces.owner_set.summary: Assign or clear the workspace owner

rpc.app.workspaces.owner_transfer.description: Permission: the workspace's current `owner_id` or a superuser — `workspace.update` alone is not enough, a co-administrator may not give away a workspace they do not answer for. Hands the workspace over: stamps `Workspace.owner_id` with the recipient AND moves the RBAC `owner` role to them, adding them to the workspace if they are not a member yet. The outgoing owner keeps their membership and every other role (`member` steps in if `owner` was their only one); the recipient is granted `owner` before the outgoing owner loses it, so the workspace is never ownerless. The recipient's `max_owned_per_user` cap is enforced unless the actor is a superuser (403 `workspace_owner_limit_reached`), because create-then-transfer would otherwise loop past it. Audited, busts both accounts' RBAC cache, 404 if the workspace or the recipient is missing, 403 for anyone but the owner or a superuser.

rpc.app.workspaces.quota_set.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`, but authority is asymmetric: a workspace admin may only LOWER a dimension below what the workspace's plan grants, and a superuser may raise it. Writes one scope's override (`workspace`, `key` or `session`) over the five dimensions — `requests_per_minute`, `heavy_per_day`, `concurrent_heavy`, `max_upload_bytes`, `max_items_per_request`. A null dimension inherits the plan's value; an all-null body deletes the override row and puts the workspace back on its plan. Returns the EFFECTIVE limits after the write (plan merged with the stored override), not the row. Audited as `workspace.quota_update`; the policy cache is dropped immediately. 422 `quota_above_inherited` (carrying `limit_name`, `limit` and `requested`) when a non-superuser raises a value, 404 if the workspace is missing. A metered call later refused by these numbers answers 429 `code=rate_limited` with `Retry-After`; the dimension that refused and the bucket it refused at ride the structured details as `details.limit_name` and `details.scope` (the gateway relays them inside `fields[0]`).

rpc.app.workspaces.set_custom_domain.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Normalizes and stores a custom domain plus a fresh DNS TXT verification token, resetting verification; 404 if workspace missing, 400 on an invalid domain.

rpc.app.workspaces.staff.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. The organizers credited on the workspace's public page: one row per person at their highest of the `owner`/`admin`/`referee` system roles, ordered owner → admin → referee then by name. `name` is the person's linked player name (BattleTag); an account with no linked player is omitted. 404 if the workspace does not exist.

rpc.app.workspaces.team_format_get.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Returns the discipline's workspace default or module preset with its slot projection.
rpc.app.workspaces.team_format_get.summary: Get a workspace's default team format

rpc.app.workspaces.team_format_put.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Sets the template for future tournaments and mixes; existing copies never change. Invalid formats return 422.
rpc.app.workspaces.team_format_put.summary: Replace a workspace's default team format

rpc.app.workspaces.verification_set.description: Permission: superuser only (a workspace owner may not self-certify). Moves a workspace between the `unverified`/`verified`/`trusted` trust tiers — the only way a self-service workspace is unblocked for GPU compute, inline achievement recompute and the public directory; audited on every call including a no-op set, 404 if workspace missing, 422 on an unknown status.

rpc.app.workspaces.verify_custom_domain.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Checks the `_owt-verify.<domain>` DNS TXT record against the stored token and stamps verified_at on a match; 404 if workspace missing, 400 if no domain is set or the record doesn't match yet.

rpc.balancer.admin.balance_export.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus `team.create` on the balance's workspace. Materializes a saved balance into tournament teams, returning removed/imported counts and emitting a teams-changed realtime event. Returns advisories for format violations and names unresolved or duplicate members skipped by the export.

rpc.balancer.admin.balance_get.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `team.read`. Returns the saved team balance for a tournament, or null when none exists.

rpc.balancer.admin.balance_ranks_export.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus `team.create` on the balance's workspace. Updates the ranks of players already materialized from the saved balance, without removing or creating any team, and emits a teams-changed realtime event.

rpc.balancer.admin.balance_save.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `team.create`. Persists a computed team balance for the tournament and emits a balance-saved realtime event.

rpc.balancer.admin.teams_import.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `team.create`. Bulk-imports tournament teams from a multipart JSON upload (atravkovs or internal format, auto-detected) and emits a teams-changed realtime event. Returns advisories for format violations and names skipped unresolved or duplicate members.

rpc.balancer.admin.tournament_config_get.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `team.read`. Returns the per-tournament balancer config, or null when none is set.

rpc.balancer.admin.tournament_config_ups.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `team.create`. Creates or updates the per-tournament balancer config and emits a balancer config-changed realtime event.

rpc.balancer.admin.tournament_summary_ge.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `team.read`. Returns the tournament id/name/status/workspace_id for the balancer tool context, hidden tournaments included.

rpc.balancer.admin.workspace_config_get.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `workspace.read`. Returns the workspace-level balancer config (rank-delta threshold, pool-hide flag and the Discord channel every mix posts its matchup to).

rpc.balancer.admin.workspace_config_upse.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `team.update`, and additionally `workspace.update` when the Discord channel actually changes. Creates or updates the workspace-level rank-delta threshold, hide-from-pool flag and the workspace-wide Discord channel for mix matchups. A newly set Discord id (mix channel, voice category, general voices) must be a text channel, category or voice channel of the workspace's own guild: 409 discord_guild_not_linked when the workspace has no guild, 422 discord_channel_not_in_guild, 503 discord_unavailable when Discord cannot be asked. Clearing a value or keeping it unchanged asks Discord nothing.

rpc.balancer.admin.workspace_ranker_get.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `workspace.read`. Returns the mix ranker's knobs in force for this workspace (the defaults when never saved) and how many hidden ratings its members hold. The ranker implements mixtura-ranker by Dmitriy (@dmelackov), https://github.com/mixtura-dev/mixtura-ranker.

rpc.balancer.admin.workspace_ranker_rebu.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `team.update`. Replays every recorded mix match of the workspace in order and replaces all hidden ratings with the result; open ranks are not touched. Returns how many matches were replayed and how many hidden ratings came out.
rpc.balancer.admin.workspace_ranker_rebu.summary: Rebuild hidden mix ratings from history

rpc.balancer.admin.workspace_ranker_upse.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `team.update`. Replaces all seven knobs at once. Changing rating_min, rating_max, rating_avg or sigma_init reinterprets every stored hidden rating, so the call rebuilds them from the workspace's recorded mix matches before answering. 422 unless rating_min < rating_avg < rating_max.

rpc.balancer.balance.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` on the given workspace_id; an API-key caller must also be scoped to that workspace and hold the `team.create` scope. Solves the posted pool and returns the ranked variants in the same response -- no job id, no polling, no realtime events. Everything the solver needs is in the body (`player_data`, optional per-team `role_mask`, optional `config_overrides`); nothing is read from the workspace. The solver budget is clamped to 60s, so a pool too large to settle in time answers 504 and belongs on the asynchronous job API instead. Rate limits, the per-key config policy and the concurrency slot are the job path's.

schema.description: The installed game the pool is balanced for.

rpc.balancer.config.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns the public balancer configuration (ranks, roles, defaults).

schema.description: Whose role weights the defaults and presets carry; absent: every role neutral. 404 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown code.

rpc.balancer.custom.add_co_host.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Grants another signed-in workspace member the same write access as the host. 404 when the target has no linked login account here, and 422 once the mix is at its co-host limit.

rpc.balancer.custom.balance.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). With `scope="lobby"` (the default) balances the non-benched lineup of ONE lobby (`lobby_index`, default 0) -- everyone another lobby is already playing or holds a pin on is left out. With `scope="all"` it splits the whole pool into `lobby_count` equally strong lobbies and balances them all. Ranks come from the host's own book above the workspace canon. 422 when the lineup is empty, a seated player has no ranked role, the mix has one lobby (`single_lobby`) or the pool cannot be split (`not_enough_players`, `too_many_must_play`, `too_many_pinned`, `roles_infeasible`). 409 match_live when the lobby -- for scope all, any lobby -- has a live match. An away player is never a candidate. A balanced lobby's running draft is cancelled.

rpc.balancer.custom.cancel_match.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Throws the lobby's live match away: its encounter is deleted with its game and rosters, nothing is recorded and no rank, pin or map moves; the lineup is ready to start again. 409 no_live_match when nothing was started.

rpc.balancer.custom.close.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Cancels every live match and every running draft, then marks the mix completed so no further writes land. Nothing is destroyed -- the mix and every match it recorded stay readable -- so this is the reversible end of a mix.

rpc.balancer.custom.create.description: Permission: workspace membership plus `custom_game.create`. Opens a pickup mix of the requested game (`discipline`, required) in the workspace and returns it with its roster; the caller becomes its host, and member_ids may be empty to start from an empty lineup. With clone_from_game_id the new mix starts from a previous mix of the same workspace -- its pool (everyone back in the pool), per-seat role setup, role shape, points per win, team names, solver overrides and co-hosts -- but never its balance result, rolled map, match history or status.

rpc.balancer.custom.delete_discord_post.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Asks the bot to delete one message this mix posted, named by its id from the mix's `discord_posts`, and returns the refreshed mix. 404 when the id belongs to another mix's message. Clicking twice is harmless; closing or cancelling a mix deletes nothing, its posts stay as history.
rpc.balancer.custom.delete_discord_post.summary: Delete one custom game Discord post

rpc.balancer.custom.draft_add_player.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Adds a present player no lobby seats to the lobby's draft as an available pick -- before the start too -- the way out of a draft short of a role. 404 not_on_roster or draft_not_found; 409 player_away or already_seated.
rpc.balancer.custom.draft_add_player.summary: Add a waiting player to a custom game draft

rpc.balancer.custom.draft_captain.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Before the draft starts, any present pool player (`player_id`, a draft player id) captains `team_id` and the draft re-seeds with the weaker captain picking first, leaving out whoever stepped away; during it, a player already on that team takes over its picks and its crown, and the picks made stand. 404 draft_not_found; 409 already_captain or not_in_pool; 422 captain_not_on_team.
rpc.balancer.custom.draft_captain.summary: Replace a custom game draft captain

rpc.balancer.custom.draft_seed.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Re-forms one lobby (`lobby_index`) as a captain draft: its seated set -- present, non-benched players, must-play first, then rotation order, minus whoever another lobby plays; exactly whom a balance of the lobby would seat -- with the two strongest as captains, the weaker picking first, snake order on the mix's pick clock. The lobby's lineup is cleared and its running draft cancelled; it reads `draft_setup` until a host starts the draft (`POST /api/v1/balancer/draft/sessions/{session_id}/start`). The last pick writes the lobby's lineup; a finished mix draft is never paused or rolled back (409 mix_draft_completed: re-form instead). 409 match_live; 422 empty_lineup, missing_ranked_role or a split code.

rpc.balancer.custom.draft_split.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Splits the seated set over every lobby by strength and seeds one captain draft per lobby, forming no team. Every running draft is cancelled and every lineup cleared. 422 single_lobby or a split code (not_enough_players, too_many_must_play, too_many_pinned, roles_infeasible); 409 match_live.
rpc.balancer.custom.draft_split.summary: Split custom game pool into lobby drafts

rpc.balancer.custom.get.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns one mix with its full lineup: each seat's participation state, role order, the ranks the balancer would use and which layer each came from. Resolves ownership from the mix id; an optional workspace_id restricts the read and returns 404 if the mix belongs to another workspace. It carries the mix's hero_ban_preset (null = no bans). It carries hero_fearless (spec §11.4), hero_ban_seconds / hero_pick_seconds (the hero room's clock per ban / per pick step in seconds; null = the preset's own), hero_free_order (a turn-by-turn pick is for whichever teammate still without a hero the picker taps) and hero_captains_only (only a team's captain or a host picks its heroes). Each lobby carries state (idle | ready | pregame | live), live_seats (the live match's participations {id, slot, name}) and opener_index (the lineup team that bans first in the next match, null without bans). Each lobby also carries lobby_code: the in-game lobby's join code its host set, null while none. A lobby's `state` reads `draft_setup` / `draft_live` while its draft runs, with `draft_session_id`; a drafted lineup's document carries `source: "draft"`. A player in a drafting lobby's pool reads that lobby as `current_lobby`; an unpicked player who stepped away leaves the pool.

schema.description: Optional community restriction; a foreign mix returns 404.

rpc.balancer.custom.hard_delete.description: Permission: workspace membership plus the workspace `admin` or `owner` role (superuser counts). Permanently erases the mix together with its roster, every match it recorded and every Discord message it posted, and returns the deleted id. Irreversible, and unlike close it is not open to the mix's own host and co-hosts.

rpc.balancer.custom.list.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. One keyset page of the workspace's mixes, newest first: `{items, next_before_id}`. Each item carries the mix's settings and host display name (no roster), `players_count` (distinct members seated across its recorded matches), `roster_count`, the most recently played `maps` (at most 4, with `maps_count` for all of them) and every lobby's `matches_count`. Optional query: `discipline` (an installed game), `status` (`open` = draft or balanced, `history` = completed or cancelled; anything else is a 422), `q` (case-insensitive substring of the mix name or the host's display name), `limit` (1..100, default 30) and `before_id` (pass the previous page's `next_before_id`; null means there is no further page).

schema.description: `open` = draft or balanced, `history` = completed or cancelled; absent = every mix.
schema.title: Status

schema.description: Case-insensitive substring of the mix name or its host's display name; blank = no filter.
schema.title: Q

schema.description: Page size, 1..100, default 30.
schema.title: Limit

schema.description: Keyset cursor: only mixes with a smaller id (the previous page's `next_before_id`).
schema.title: Before Id

rpc.balancer.custom.match_history.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns every round recorded for the mix, newest first: its two teams by slot (slot 1 banned first) with name and score, its hero bans {slot, item_id} in order, whose hero each pick was {slot, member_id, name, item_id} in pick order, the winning slot (null for a draw), lobby, map, recorder and the rank points it applied.

rpc.balancer.custom.post_discord.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Queues the lobby's lineup post -- the balance option the lobby is showing, the next map and the points at stake -- to the workspace-wide mix channel and returns immediately: discord-service renders the card, keeps it in step with the board and delivers it, and nothing about the mix changes. A multi-lobby mix names the lobby on the card and numbers the match within that lobby. 409 when the workspace has no mix channel configured and 404 when the balance option is missing.
rpc.balancer.custom.post_discord.summary: Post custom game lineup to Discord

rpc.balancer.custom.post_signup.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Opens self-signup in the given mode (into the pool or onto the bench) and queues the signup card with Join / My roles / Leave buttons to the workspace-wide mix channel. discord-service renders it and keeps it in step with the roster; every click re-reads the mix, so it refuses correctly once signup closes or the mix ends. A mix has one signup card: posting again deletes the previous one from the channel first. 409 when the workspace has no mix channel configured.
rpc.balancer.custom.post_signup.summary: Open custom game signup in Discord

rpc.balancer.custom.record_outcome.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Records the result of the lobby's live match -- the one Start match opened on the lineup it froze -- and completes its encounter, moving both teams' ranks in the host's book (by points_per_win when a winner is given, or seat by seat by the mix ranker when the host's rating_mode is 'ranker'), advancing the workspace's hidden ratings and redeeming every seat's must_play pin back to the pool. The match is stamped with its lobby and with whoever was playing another lobby at that moment, whom rotation then counts as neither played nor sat out. The lobby's next map is cleared. 409 no_live_match when nothing was started. Repeatable until the mix is closed. The winner names the lineup team (1 or 2), whichever slot Start seated it in.

rpc.balancer.custom.remove_co_host.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Revokes a co-host grant, including a co-host removing themselves, and returns the refreshed mix. An account that has since left the workspace stays revocable.

rpc.balancer.custom.rename.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Replaces the mix's name (trimmed, 1-255 characters) and re-renders its live Discord signup card. Refused once the mix is closed.

rpc.balancer.custom.rotation.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Recommends who is owed the next seat and who should sit out, computed from this mix's own match history, read-only. The optional lobby_index query parameter ranks the candidates of one lobby -- whoever is seated in another lobby or pinned to one is left out -- and splits at that lobby's seat count.

schema.description: Which lobby to rank candidates for (0 or 1); defaults to 0.

rpc.balancer.custom.self_away.description: Permission: a seated account; the account links are required as for a role edit, the host's 'players edit their own roles' switch is not. Sets or clears the caller's own away flag: an away player keeps their row, roles and must-play mark, but no balance, lobby split or rotation seats them until they are back, and every match recorded meanwhile counts them as busy (neither played nor sat out). It never clears itself. It reaches the lobby's running draft as the host's away flag does. 404 when the caller has no seat, 409 once the mix is over.

rpc.balancer.custom.self_current.description: Permission: any authenticated account; workspace membership is NOT required. Same answer as `self_get`, for the workspace's newest mix that is neither completed nor cancelled -- what `/mix` in Discord asks, where the player names no id. 404 when the workspace is running nothing.
rpc.balancer.custom.self_current.summary: Get my seat in the current mix

rpc.balancer.custom.self_get.description: Permission: any authenticated account; workspace membership is NOT required. Returns the caller's own seat in the mix (participation, role order, the ranks the host's book resolves for them) plus what they may do next: join, leave, edit roles, and the blocker code for each. `seat` is null when the caller is not on the roster.

rpc.balancer.custom.self_join.description: Permission: any authenticated account with both Discord and Battle.net linked and `custom_game.self_join` not denied; workspace membership is created on the way in. Seats the caller according to the mix's signup mode (pool or bench) and returns the same state as the read. Idempotent: an existing row is left untouched, bench included. 403 for an unlinked account, 409 when signup is closed, the mix is over or the roster is full.

rpc.balancer.custom.self_leave.description: Permission: any authenticated account holding a seat in this mix -- the account links are deliberately NOT required, so unlinking one cannot trap somebody in a lineup. Removes the caller's own roster row; the stored balance is kept until the host re-balances. 404 when the caller has no seat, 409 once the mix is over.

rpc.balancer.custom.self_update.description: Permission: a seated account, while the host's 'players edit their own roles' switch is on. Re-orders the caller's own roles (null = every role they have a rank for) and flips their flex flag; participation and ranks stay the host's. The shown balance is not recomputed -- the change applies to the next one. 409 when the switch is off, 404 when the caller has no seat.

rpc.balancer.custom.set_ban_preset.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Sets the hero ban preset the lobbies' next Start opens a room on -- a hero preset of the mix's own game that bans no player on map 1 (deadlock_hero_bans, deadlock_bans_pick, deadlock_bans_pick_turns, deadlock_two_phase_draft, lol_side_selection, lol_draft, lol_captains, the Overwatch hero presets) -- or null for no bans, and returns the refreshed mix. A live match keeps the room it started with. 422 unknown_ban_preset for any other code. hero_fearless, when sent, turns Fearless on or off for the next room: a player cannot pick a hero they were recorded on earlier in the mix. hero_ban_seconds / hero_pick_seconds, when sent, set the next room's clock in seconds (10..600; null = the preset's own) for every ban and protect step / every pick step -- an all-at-once pick is one step, so its clock is the whole pick's; a side pick or an assignment keeps the preset's clock. hero_free_order, when sent, frees the next room's turn-by-turn picks (lol_draft, deadlock_bans_pick_turns, deadlock_two_phase_draft): the team's turn is for whichever teammate still without a hero its picker names, and one the clock runs out on goes to the first of them in lineup order. hero_captains_only, when sent, leaves every player pick of the next room to the team's captain (or a host), for any teammate; a team whose lineup has no captain still picks for itself.

rpc.balancer.custom.set_captain.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Makes one seated player the captain of their team in the option the lobby is showing and returns the refreshed mix. A balance captains each team by its strongest seat; a swap that moves a captain re-captains both teams. 404 when that option does not seat the player. 409 match_live while the lobby's match is live.

rpc.balancer.custom.set_draft_settings.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Sets how the mix's lobbies form teams by default -- 'balance' (the solver) or 'draft' (a captain draft) -- and the draft's pick clock in seconds (10..600), then returns the refreshed mix. A running draft keeps its clock; both apply from the next formation. 422 for any other value.

rpc.balancer.custom.set_lobby_code.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Stores the in-game lobby's join code (trimmed, up to 64 characters) so players do not have to ask for it, or clears it with null or a blank string. Public like the rest of the lobby: the mix read and the posted lineup card show it. Kept across matches until the host changes it, and writable while the lobby's match is live. The lobby_index field names the lobby; a single-lobby mix leaves it at 0.

rpc.balancer.custom.set_lobby_count.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Runs the mix as 1..6 lobbies. Growing opens the new lobbies empty, leaving the running ones untouched; shrinking deletes every lobby past the new count together with its stored matchup and clears the pins that named them. Matches already recorded for a deleted lobby stay in the history and in the statistics. 409 match_live when a lobby it would drop has a live match.

rpc.balancer.custom.set_next_map.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Names the map the lobby's next match is played on -- rolled or picked by a host ahead of the lobby -- or clears it with null. The next recorded match takes this map unless the outcome names one explicitly, and clears it either way. The lobby_index field names which lobby's roll this is; a single-lobby mix leaves it at 0. 404 when the map is not in the catalogue. 409 match_live while the lobby's match is live.

rpc.balancer.custom.set_participation.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Moves several seats between must_play, pool and benched in one transaction -- the whole rotation verdict at once -- and returns the refreshed mix; 404 if any member is not on the roster.

rpc.balancer.custom.set_self_service.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Sets whether players may seat themselves (closed, into the pool, or onto the bench) and whether a seated player may re-order their own roles, then returns the refreshed mix.

rpc.balancer.custom.set_team_names.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Renames the balanced teams by index and returns the refreshed mix.

rpc.balancer.custom.set_variant_index.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Pages one lobby to one of the balance options its last run produced, for every viewer at once -- the option on screen is a fact about the lobby, not about one browser. 404 when the index points past the stored options, and 409 seat_conflict when the option would seat somebody another of the mix's lobbies has already put on the floor. Re-balancing resets it to the first option. 409 match_live while the lobby's match is live.
rpc.balancer.custom.set_variant_index.summary: Set custom game shown balance option

rpc.balancer.custom.start_match.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Starts the lobby's match on the option it is showing: an open encounter with both teams' rosters (captains flagged) and one game on the lobby's next map. The lineup is then frozen until the result is recorded or the match is cancelled. When the lobby has both team voices, its seated players are then moved into them (as voice_move; a Discord failure leaves the match started). 409 match_live when the lobby already has a live match, 404 when the shown option is gone, 422 unless it seats two teams. Both seats are marked ready. With a hero ban preset the team that bans first (the last round's loser when the same two teams meet again, else the lower average rating; flip_opener swaps it) is seated in slot 1 and tournament-service opens the ban room; the lobby reads pregame until the room is done.

rpc.balancer.custom.stats.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Per-member wins/losses/draws, win rate, current streak and the per-role split across the mixes this workspace has run, best record first. The optional `discipline` query parameter narrows it to one enabled game (422 `discipline_not_enabled` for another): seats, roles and `identity` (the member's handle for that game's identity provider) are that game's. Without it (or `all`) the scoreboard spans every game, `identity` is the member's first handle in any game's provider, and `by_role` is null -- role codes of different games are different roles. The optional since query parameter (ISO 8601) narrows it to matches played (started) on or after that moment; without it the whole history counts. Each member also carries `player_id` (the global player, null once the member is no longer on the roster) and `form`: their newest results first (in the order they were recorded), at most 10, each `{outcome, match_id, played_at, recorded_at}`. Top-level `mixes` and `matches` count the distinct mixes and recorded matches inside the same window. Read-only.

schema.description: One enabled discipline; omitted or `all` = every game (by_role is then null).
ISO 8601 instant; only matches recorded on or after it.

rpc.balancer.custom.swap_seats.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Swaps two seated players between teams inside one balance option, same role only, and returns the refreshed mix; a swap that moves a team's captain re-captains both teams. 404 when the option or either seat is missing, 422 when the seats hold different roles or sit on the same team. 409 match_live while the lobby's match is live.

rpc.balancer.custom.transfer_host.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Hands primary ownership to another signed-in member of the workspace, dropping their co-host grant if they held one. 404 when the target has no linked login account here, since a host is an auth.user id and not a roster member.

rpc.balancer.custom.undo_match.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Deletes the lobby's most recent match and gives back exactly the rank points it applied, read from the match and its seats rather than the host's current settings, then rebuilds the workspace's hidden ratings from the remaining history. 404 when the match belongs to another mix and 409 when a newer match of the SAME lobby exists, since the rank book compounds. must_play pins the recording redeemed are not restored.

rpc.balancer.custom.update_player.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Patches one seat's participation state, role order, flex flag or away flag and returns the refreshed mix; 404 when the member is not on this mix's roster. An away flag that flips reaches the lobby's running draft: a picked player stepping away, or a pool left unable to fill every role, pauses a live draft (a return never does), and its board re-reads the seats either way.

rpc.balancer.custom.update_roster.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Replaces the mix lineup with the given workspace_member ids (at most 100) and returns the refreshed mix. A member with no linked login account can be rostered here, unlike the host and co-host grants.

rpc.balancer.custom.voice_options.description: Permission: workspace membership plus being the mix's host or co-host (or a superuser). Returns the voice channels of the workspace's mix voice category, split into `general` and `team` voices, each with the bot's `missing_permissions`. `error` is set instead of failing when Discord is unreachable or the category is gone (`category_not_found`); with no category configured both lists are empty.

rpc.balancer.draft.cancel.description: Permission: whoever runs the session's owner -- a tournament workspace's `team.create`, or the mix's host or a co-host (or a superuser). Cancels the draft and publishes a draft-cancelled realtime event.

rpc.balancer.draft.chat_delete.description: Permission: the message's author, or a moderator of the room (workspace staff). Soft-deletes one message and publishes the removal to the room's subscribers. 404 when the id is not a message of this room. Answers `{deleted: true}`.

rpc.balancer.draft.chat_history.description: Permission: optional authentication. Captains of the session's teams and the workspace's staff always read; anybody else reads while the room's `spectators_can_read` is on, which a draft room has ON by default (a draft is a show). A hidden tournament is visible only to its workspace's admins and its preview allowlist. The room is the SESSION, so a re-seed starts a new conversation. Returns the messages plus the room settings, the caller's own viewer rights and — for moderators only — the active mutes. `after_id` tails the room; `limit` pages it.

schema.description: Only messages newer than this id (live tail).
Page size, clamped to 1..200, default 50.

rpc.balancer.draft.chat_mute_clear.description: Permission: moderator of the room (workspace staff). Lifts one account's mute in this room, idempotent. Answers `{deleted: true}`.
rpc.balancer.draft.chat_mute_clear.summary: Unmute an account in the draft chat

rpc.balancer.draft.chat_mute_set.description: Permission: moderator of the room (workspace staff). Mutes one account in this room for `minutes` (1..10080), or until lifted when `minutes` is null, with an optional reason. 422 on muting yourself. Returns the mute.
rpc.balancer.draft.chat_mute_set.summary: Mute an account in the draft chat

rpc.balancer.draft.chat_post.description: Permission: authenticated captain of one of the session's teams, or workspace staff; spectators never write, at any setting. The body is sanitized and capped at 500 characters. 403 with code `chat_muted` while the account is muted in this room, 429 past 10 messages per 10 seconds. Returns the stored message, which is also fanned out to the room's realtime topic.
rpc.balancer.draft.chat_post.summary: Post to the draft room chat

rpc.balancer.draft.chat_settings.description: Permission: moderator of the room (workspace staff). Opens or closes the room to spectators and returns the stored setting. Closing it also revokes the spectators already subscribed to the room's realtime topic; a no-op toggle emits nothing.

rpc.balancer.draft.export.description: Permission: workspace `team.create`. Finalizes the drafted rosters into tournament teams and publishes a draft-completed realtime event. The returned session includes advisories for format violations and names skipped unresolved or duplicate members.

rpc.balancer.draft.export_ranks.description: Permission: workspace `team.create`. Updates the ranks of players already exported from this completed draft, leaving the tournament teams themselves untouched.

rpc.balancer.draft.feasibility.description: Permission: a tournament workspace's `team.read`, or the mix's hosts. Reports whether every remaining team-role slot can be filled.

rpc.balancer.draft.journal.description: Permission: whoever runs the session's owner -- a tournament workspace's `team.create`, or the mix's host or a co-host (or a superuser). Returns the session's audit trail newest first -- picks, autopicks, overrides, clock extensions and every lifecycle move -- with the acting account's name resolved (null for the clock and other system actions). `limit` defaults to 100 and is clamped to 500.

schema.description: Page size, clamped to 1..500, default 100.

rpc.balancer.draft.pause.description: Permission: whoever runs the session's owner -- a tournament workspace's `team.create`, or the mix's host or a co-host (or a superuser). Pauses an in-progress draft and publishes a draft-paused realtime event.

rpc.balancer.draft.pick_autopick.description: Permission: whoever runs the session's owner -- a tournament workspace's `team.create`, or the mix's host or a co-host (or a superuser). Auto-selects the best-fit available player for a pick using the session's autopick strategy and broadcasts the result.

rpc.balancer.draft.pick_extend.description: Permission: whoever runs the session's owner -- a tournament workspace's `team.create`, or the mix's host or a co-host (or a superuser). Adds seconds to the current on-clock pick — to its deadline while the draft is live, to the frozen remainder while it is paused — and broadcasts the new deadline.

rpc.balancer.draft.pick_options.description: Permission: the on-clock captain of the pick's team, or a workspace admin. Returns safe and blocked player-role choices for the current pick. A tournament's workspace admin or a mix's host may pick for whichever team is on the clock.

rpc.balancer.draft.pick_override.description: Permission: whoever runs the session's owner -- a tournament workspace's `team.create`, or the mix's host or a co-host (or a superuser). Overrides a pick to an arbitrary player, bypassing captain/clock constraints, and broadcasts a pick-made event.

rpc.balancer.draft.pick_select.description: Permission: the on-clock captain of the pick's team, or a workspace admin. Makes a pick for the current slot, enforcing role fit and optimistic version, then broadcasts pick-made/next-pick events. A tournament's workspace admin or a mix's host may pick for whichever team is on the clock.

rpc.balancer.draft.player_role_edit.description: Permission: whoever runs the session's owner -- a tournament workspace's `team.create`, or the mix's host or a co-host (or a superuser). Previews or commits an emergency role addition to the draft snapshot with optimistic versioning and private audit reason; 422 `role_edit_tournament_only` on a mix's draft, whose ranks are edited in the mix.
rpc.balancer.draft.player_role_edit.summary: Preview or add a draft player role

rpc.balancer.draft.queue_get.description: Permission: that team's own captain, or whoever runs the draft. Returns the team's private autopick priority in stored order, filtered to players still available, plus `autopick_preview` -- exactly what autopick would take -- while this team is on the clock. Never part of the public board.

rpc.balancer.draft.queue_set.description: Permission: that team's own captain, or whoever runs the draft. Replaces the queue with the given order (max 60, duplicates collapsed to their first placement); 422 when an id is not an available non-captain player of this draft, 409 once the draft is completed or cancelled. Publishes no realtime event -- a queue is private to its team.
