rpc.balancer.draft.resume.description: Permission: whoever runs the session's owner -- a tournament workspace's `team.create`, or the mix's host or a co-host (or a superuser). Resumes a paused draft and publishes a draft-resumed realtime event.

rpc.balancer.draft.rollback.description: Permission: whoever runs the session's owner -- a tournament workspace's `team.create`, or the mix's host or a co-host (or a superuser). Rolls back the most recent draft action and publishes a rollback realtime event. A mix draft refuses to roll back the pick that seated its team's current captain (409 rollback_frees_captain): the host replaces the captain with a player who stays first.

rpc.balancer.draft.seed.description: Permission: workspace `team.create`. Seeds a draft session with captains and players from the balancer pool; 422 when no pool captains are provided.

rpc.balancer.draft.session_board.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns the full draft board snapshot (teams, picks, pool) for a given session id.

rpc.balancer.draft.session_create.description: Permission: workspace `team.create`. Creates a new draft session for a tournament and publishes a session-updated realtime event. The draft format (and, for `custom`, its round rules) comes from the tournament's `draft_format_json`, not from the request.

rpc.balancer.draft.session_delete.description: Permission: workspace `team.create`. Permanently erases a draft session with its teams, pool, picks and audit trail; 409 while the draft is live or paused. Teams already exported to the tournament are kept.

rpc.balancer.draft.session_get.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a single draft session by id for spectating.

rpc.balancer.draft.session_list.description: Permission: workspace `team.read`. Returns every draft session ever created for a tournament, newest first.

rpc.balancer.draft.session_patch.description: Permission: workspace `team.create`. Updates mutable draft settings (pick time, autopick strategy, override flag, rounds, settings) before the draft starts.

rpc.balancer.draft.start.description: Permission: whoever runs the session's owner -- a tournament workspace's `team.create`, or the mix's host or a co-host (or a superuser), and only a superuser may start a tournament's draft outside its draft phase (a mix draft has no phase). Starts the draft and opens the first pick, publishing a pick-started realtime event with the clock deadline.

rpc.balancer.draft.suggestions.description: Permission: a tournament workspace's `team.read`, or the mix's hosts. Ranks the top five available players by fit for the current pick; 409 if the draft has no current pick.

rpc.balancer.draft.team_fit.description: Permission: that team's own captain, or whoever runs the draft. Scores every available player against every role this team can still seat, normalized 1..99 across the response (50 when all candidates tie). `role` is null under a role-less (all-flex) roster shape, where each player has exactly one entry. Empty once the team's roster is full or the draft is completed/cancelled.

rpc.balancer.draft.tournament_board.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns the live draft board snapshot for a tournament's active session, or null when no session is active.

rpc.balancer.jobs.create.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` on the given workspace_id; an API-key caller must also be scoped to that workspace and hold the `team.create` scope. Queues an asynchronous balance job from a multipart player-data upload plus optional config overrides, returning 202 with the job id.

schema.description: The game the upload is balanced for (enabled in the workspace); required without tournament_id, and must equal the tournament's game with one.

rpc.balancer.jobs.create_for_tournament.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` on the tournament's workspace; an API-key caller must also be scoped to that workspace and hold the `team.create` scope. Queues an asynchronous balance job built server-side from the tournament's own pool registrations -- nothing is uploaded -- returning 202 with the job id; 422 when no pool registration has a ranked role.

rpc.balancer.jobs.result.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` on the job's own workspace, and an API key may read only the jobs it created itself. Returns the computed result of a completed balance job by its uuid.

rpc.balancer.jobs.status.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` on the job's own workspace, and an API key may read only the jobs it created itself. Returns the current status of a balance job by its uuid.

rpc.balancer.players.authors.description: Permission: workspace membership (any role); no resource grant is checked. Returns everyone who has personally rank-corrected a member in this workspace, busiest first, with their display name and correction count.

rpc.balancer.players.list.description: Permission: workspace membership (any role); no resource grant is checked. Returns a page of the workspace roster carrying two rank dictionaries that are never merged: `ranks` is the workspace canon and `author_ranks` is one author's own book, which is what lets a row say whether a number is its own or inherited. Another organiser's book is readable through `author_user_id`. Optional `discipline` (query on reads, body on writes) picks whose rated roles the ranks are held on and whose identity provider names each row's `identity`; omitted, the workspace's first enabled discipline (422 `discipline_not_enabled` for another). Observation-only anchors are not roster members and never listed.

schema.description: Enabled discipline; defaults to the workspace's first.
1-based page, default 1.
Page size, clamped to 1..100, default 30.
Needle matched against the identity handle, display_name and name.
Whose rank book to read into author_ranks; defaults to the caller.
Keep only members that read author has personally ranked.

rpc.balancer.players.set_ranks.description: Permission: workspace membership (any role); no resource grant is checked. Writes one rank layer for a member and returns that layer. `scope: "workspace"` edits the shared canon every author inherits; `scope: "author"` edits the caller's own book and takes no author id, so nobody can rewrite another organiser's ranks. `clear` deletes roles from the layer instead of zeroing them, so a cleared author rank falls back to canon, while an omitted role is left alone. 404 when the member belongs to another workspace. The body's `discipline` is required (422 when omitted) and picks whose rated roles the ranks are held on; it must be enabled for the workspace (422 `discipline_not_enabled`). A role code outside that discipline's rated module roles -- `flex` included -- is 422 `unknown_role`.

rpc.balancer.players.summary.description: Permission: workspace membership (any role); no resource grant is checked. Returns the workspace roster size alongside how many of those members the read author has personally ranked, which is what the "My ranks" filter counts.

schema.description: Whose rank book author_total counts; defaults to the caller.

rpc.balancer.players.upsert.description: Permission: workspace member holding team.create or custom_game.create (a mix host); setting display_name requires team.create. Admits (or reuses) the workspace member a game identity denotes and returns it shaped exactly like a roster row. The body is `{discipline, identity: {provider, handle}, display_name?}`; `discipline` must be enabled for the workspace (422 `discipline_not_enabled`), `identity.provider` must be that discipline's identity provider (422 `identity.provider_mismatch`) and the handle must fit its grammar (422 with the provider's format code, e.g. `identity.riot.format`). Several distinct players carrying the handle is 409 `identity_conflict`; no player yet creates an unlinked one. Unknown keys (such as `battle_tag`) are 422.

rpc.balancer.prefs.get.description: Permission: self-service -- any authenticated (active) account reads its own preferences only. Returns the signed-in account's own mix settings -- the rank-balance/role-comfort tilt, the per-role weights, the open-slot weight, how many balance options to keep, how far a decided match moves its rank book and whether the mix ranker moves it instead (rating_mode). A null value means the setting was never saved and the default applies. The team format is not here: it is frozen on each mix. hero_ban_presets maps a game to the hero ban preset a new mix of it starts with. formation_defaults maps a game to how a new mix of it forms teams (team_formation, draft_pick_seconds).

rpc.balancer.prefs.upsert.description: Permission: self-service -- any authenticated (active) account writes its own preferences only. Replaces all eight of the caller's mix settings at once and returns the stored result, exactly what the next read returns; a null clears one back to the default, and 0 points per win stores as unset. They apply to every mix this account hosts -- a mix runs on its host's preferences whoever presses the button. 422 on an unknown field or an out-of-range value. 422 when a hero_ban_presets entry is not a hero preset of its own game. 422 when formation_defaults names a game that is not installed or a pick clock outside 10..600.

rpc.balancer.ranks.list.description: Permission: workspace member holding `team.update` -- the same grant writing the canon needs, because this read puts every author's private book on one screen. Read-only. One flat row per rank value across nine layers (canon, author, native, hidden, effective_tournament, effective_mix, registration, tournament, casual); the six current layers are the default. The two effective layers are computed in SQL and agree with the resolver the balancer runs on: effective_tournament is canon over the game's native rank on the workspace grid, effective_mix is the author's book over the canon over the native rank on the same workspace grid. `division` is resolved on the workspace's effective grid of the row's game. Filtering, sorting, the exact total and the page all run in the database. Optional `discipline` reads one enabled game (422 `discipline_not_enabled` for another); without it the rows are the union over every game the workspace runs, each tagged with its `discipline`, and `role`, `div_min`, `div_max` and `sort=rank_value|division` are a 422 (`<param> requires discipline`): those values live on different grids. A game with no grid here lists its rows with a null `division`, and a `div_min`/`div_max` on it is a 422 `division_grid_required`.

schema.description: One enabled discipline; omitted = every enabled discipline.
1-based page, default 1.
Page size, clamped to 1..200, default 50.
Only this players.user id.
Needle matched against the identity handle, display_name and name.

Repeatable. One of ['canon', 'author', 'native', 'hidden', 'effective_tournament', 'effective_mix', 'registration', 'tournament', 'casual']; defaults to the current layers ['canon', 'author', 'native', 'hidden', 'effective_tournament', 'effective_mix'].
Repeatable. Only these authors/hosts.
Repeatable rated module role code; requires discipline.
Best division kept: a tier number on the workspace grid of the game, 1 = top, inclusive; requires discipline.
Worst division kept: a tier number on the workspace grid of the game, 1 = top, inclusive (ranks below the floor tier count in it); requires discipline. div_min > div_max is a 400.
Keep only author rows whose canon_diff IS DISTINCT FROM 0.
ISO-8601 lower bound on `at`.
ISO-8601 upper bound on `at`.
One of ['at', 'rank_value', 'display_name', 'layer', 'role', 'canon_diff', 'delta']; default display_name.
asc|desc, default asc.

rpc.balancer.ranks.list.summary: List all rank values in the workspace

rpc.balancer.teams.export_registered.description: Permission: admin-panel access plus workspace `team.create`. Materializes the tournament's complete registered teams into balancer teams, optionally narrowed to given team ids, and returns removed/imported/created counts plus every team skipped and why, and emits a teams-changed realtime event when anything was imported.

rpc.discord.channel.backfill.description: Permission: workspace `discord_channel.update` in the tournament's workspace. Starts a rescan of the last 500 messages of the tournament's active Discord channel, resubmitting every log attachment found; returns an ack immediately, the scan itself is asynchronous, and 404s when no active channel is configured. Ingestion deduplicates on the SHA-256 of a log file's bytes, so logs already processed for the tournament are skipped rather than duplicated, but each call re-downloads and re-uploads every attachment — repeat it only when logs are genuinely missing.

rpc.discord.channel.delete.description: Permission: workspace `discord_channel.delete` in the tournament's workspace. Removes a tournament's Discord channel configuration and returns no content, 404ing when no channel is configured.

rpc.discord.channel.get.description: Permission: workspace `discord_channel.read` in the tournament's workspace. Returns the Discord channel configuration for a tournament (or null).

rpc.discord.channel.upsert.description: Permission: workspace `discord_channel.update` in the tournament's workspace. Creates or updates the tournament's match-log channel binding; the bot starts or stops watching it at once. The channel must be a text channel of the workspace's linked Discord server: 409 `discord_guild_not_linked` when the workspace has none, 422 `discord_channel_not_in_guild` otherwise, 503 `discord_unavailable` when Discord could not be asked.

rpc.discord.workspace_channels.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Returns `{guild_id, channels}`: the text, voice and category channels of the workspace's linked Discord server with their categories and, for voice and categories, the permissions the bot lacks to move members. `guild_id` is null and `channels` empty when no server is linked; when the bot cannot read the server the list is empty and `error` carries a code (`guild_not_found`, `discord_error`) instead of failing the call.

rpc.discord.workspace_guild.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Returns connection status, server name, icon URL, member count, and Discord owner of the workspace's linked Discord server. With no server linked `connected` is false and the rest null; when the bot cannot read the server the answer is `{guild_id, connected: false, error}` with a code (`guild_not_found`, `discord_error`).

rpc.discord.workspace_roles.description: Permission: workspace `workspace.update`. Returns `{guild_id, roles}`: the roles of the workspace's linked Discord server with names, colors and positions, highest first, from the bot's gateway cache. `guild_id` is null and `roles` empty when no server is linked; when the bot cannot read the server the list is empty and `error` carries a code (`guild_not_found`, `discord_error`) instead of failing the call.

rpc.identity.api_key.quota_set.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` on the key's own workspace, which must be active (a global `team.create` grant or superuser also passes). Overrides the five limit dimensions -- requests_per_minute, heavy_per_day, concurrent_heavy, max_upload_bytes, max_items_per_request -- for one API key; a body whose values are all null deletes the override and puts the key back on what its workspace and plan hand down. A superuser may raise or lower; anyone else may only lower, and a value above what the key would inherit is refused with 422, envelope `code: unprocessable` and `details.fields[0] = {code: quota_above_inherited, limit_name, limit, requested}`. Journalled as `api_key.quota_update` with the previous and new dimension maps.

rpc.identity.api_key.quota_usage.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` on the key's own workspace, which must be active (a global `team.create` grant or superuser also passes). Returns the plan slug and one entry per applicable scope (workspace, then key), each pairing the effective ceiling with what has been spent against it; a null ceiling means unlimited. Redis being unreachable reports zero consumption rather than failing the read.

rpc.identity.api_key.self.description: Permission: an API-key credential; no further grant is checked. Returns the descriptor -- name, scopes, config policy, expiry -- of the API key presented on this request, so a scripted client can discover its own authority. A session bearer gets 403.

rpc.identity.api_key.self_quota.description: Permission: an API-key credential; no further grant is checked, and a session bearer gets 403. The same per-scope ceiling-and-consumption report as rpc.identity.api_key.quota_usage, for the key presented on this request, so a scripted client can pace itself instead of discovering its ceiling by hitting it. Once a ceiling is hit, the metered endpoint answers 429 with envelope `code: rate_limited`, `details.fields[0] = {code: quota_exceeded, limit_name, scope, limit}` and `details.retry_after` seconds, which the gateway also writes as a Retry-After header.
rpc.identity.api_key.self_quota.summary: Read the calling API key's own budget

rpc.identity.create_api_key.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` on the target workspace, which must be active (a global `team.create` grant or superuser also passes), and the key can only carry scopes the creator already holds there. Creates a workspace-scoped API key for the active user and returns it including the one-time plaintext key (201).

rpc.identity.delete_me.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — the caller's own account only. Permanently deletes the active user's own account (sessions, OAuth connections, API keys, role grants) and returns 204. Historical data is preserved: the linked player identity survives with its account link nulled, so tournaments, matches, statistics and registrations are untouched. 400 for a superuser account. Re-authentication: an account with a password sends `{"current_password": ...}` (400 when missing, 401 when wrong); a passwordless account needs a session that signed in within the last 10 minutes, else 403 `reauth_required`.

rpc.identity.get_me.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user, session bearer or API key; self-service. Returns the profile of the bearer-authenticated user; `has_password` tells whether the account has a password (else it signs in through OAuth only).

rpc.identity.invalidate_session.description: Permission: a valid service token carrying the `identity:invalidate` scope (403 without it); no user credential. Drops the cached RBAC entry for the given user_id, so their next request re-resolves roles and permissions from the database instead of waiting out the cache TTL; returns 204 No Content. Despite the endpoint name it does NOT revoke tokens or end sessions — an issued access token stays valid until it expires. Use the session endpoints for revocation.
rpc.identity.invalidate_session.summary: Invalidate cached permissions for a user

rpc.identity.link_complete.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — the identity attaches to the bearer caller and the owt_xdomain_guard cookie must match. Redeems a pending-link ticket minted by rpc.identity.oauth_link and attaches the provider identity it carries to the bearer-authenticated caller; 400 if the ticket is invalid, expired, or already used.

rpc.identity.list_api_keys.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` on the requested workspace, which must be active (a global `team.create` grant or superuser also passes). Returns the active user's API keys for the given workspace_id (422 if workspace_id is missing).

rpc.identity.list_sessions.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — only the caller's own sessions. Returns all active refresh-token sessions for the bearer-authenticated user.

rpc.identity.login.description: Permission: public; no authentication required — the email/password pair is the credential. Authenticates email + password and returns an access+refresh token, recording the session with the forwarded user-agent and IP. After 10 failed attempts for one email within 15 minutes, that email is locked for 15 minutes: 429 `Too many failed login attempts. Try again later.`, checked before the password; a successful login clears the count.

rpc.identity.logout.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — 403 when the refresh token belongs to another account. Revokes the supplied refresh token for the bearer-authenticated user; returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.logout_all.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — only the caller's own sessions. Revokes every refresh-token session for the active user; returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.me.avatar_delete.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service, and refused when the caller carries an `account.avatar` deny. Removes the active user's avatar from S3 and returns the updated user.

rpc.identity.me.avatar_set.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service, and refused when the caller carries an `account.avatar` deny. Uploads the active user's avatar image to S3 (base64 multipart body) and returns the updated user.

rpc.identity.oauth_callback.description: Permission: public; no authentication required — the provider's code+state is the credential. Exchanges the provider's code+state for an access+refresh token, logging in or creating the user; 422 if provider/code/state are missing.

rpc.identity.oauth_connections.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service. Returns the OAuth provider connections linked to the active user.

rpc.identity.oauth_link.description: Permission: public entry point; a bearer is optional and resolved best-effort — a platform-host link needs a resolvable active user, a custom-domain link needs none. Exchanges the provider code+state and links the connection to the active user (platform apex/subdomain), or -- for a workspace custom domain, which has no live session here -- mints a single-use provider-identity ticket (mode='link_ticket') for rpc.identity.link_complete to redeem instead.

rpc.identity.oauth_providers.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns the configured OAuth providers and their availability.

rpc.identity.oauth_unlink.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service. Unlinks the named OAuth provider from the active user; returns 204 and refuses to remove the last provider when no password is set.

rpc.identity.oauth_url.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns the provider's authorization redirect URL to start the OAuth flow; 400 if the provider is missing.

rpc.identity.player.link.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — the link is made to the caller's own account and only when one of the caller's Discord/Battle.net OAuth identities matches the player's handles. Links a game player to the active user and returns the link details (201).

rpc.identity.player.linked.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — only the caller's own link. Returns all game players linked to the active user.

rpc.identity.player.unlink.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — 404 unless the player is linked to the caller. Unlinks a game player from the active user by player_id; returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.rbac.add_user_deny.description: Permission: global `auth_user.update`. Adds a deny for one permission on the given user and returns the user's full deny list. workspace_id scopes the deny to a single workspace; omitted or null denies the permission everywhere, and a user may hold both at once. The deny takes precedence over every role grant that would otherwise confer the permission, and the RBAC cache is busted so it applies to the next request. Idempotent. 400 for a governance permission (denying the RBAC surface itself could lock administration out), 404 for an unknown user, permission or workspace.
rpc.identity.rbac.add_user_deny.summary: Deny a permission to a user

rpc.identity.rbac.assign_linked_player.description: Permission: global `auth_user.update`. Links a game player to the given auth user (admin); returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.rbac.assign_role.description: Permission: `role.update` in the granted role's own scope (a workspace role needs the workspace grant, no global fallback), and the role may not carry a permission the caller lacks. Assigns a role to a user and invalidates the RBAC cache; returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.rbac.create_permission.description: Permission: superuser only. Creates a new RBAC permission and returns it (201).

rpc.identity.rbac.create_role.description: Permission: `role.create` in the new role's own scope — workspace `role.create` for a workspace role (no global fallback), global `role.create` otherwise — and the role may not carry a permission the caller lacks. Creates a new RBAC role and returns it (201).

rpc.identity.rbac.delete_auth_user.description: Permission: superuser only. Permanently deletes another user's login account: the auth user row and, by cascade, its roles, permission denies, sessions/refresh tokens, OAuth connections, API keys and preview-access grants; returns 204. The linked players.user survives with its auth_user_id nulled, so tournament history, statistics and workspace membership outlive the login account. 400 when deleting yourself, 404 if the user id is unknown.

rpc.identity.rbac.delete_oauth_connectio.description: Permission: global `auth_user.update`. Deletes an OAuth connection by connection_id (admin); returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.rbac.delete_permission.description: Permission: superuser only. Deletes the RBAC permission by id; returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.rbac.delete_role.description: Permission: `role.delete` in the role's own scope (a workspace role needs the workspace grant, no global fallback). Deletes the role by role_id; returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.rbac.get_auth_user.description: Permission: global `auth_user.read`. Returns detailed info for a single auth user by user_id (422 if user_id is missing).

rpc.identity.rbac.get_role.description: Permission: `role.read` in the role's own scope, with a global `role.read` fallback for a workspace role. Returns a single role with its permissions by role_id (422 if role_id is missing).

rpc.identity.rbac.get_user_roles.description: Permission: global `auth_user.read`. Returns the roles assigned to the given user_id.

rpc.identity.rbac.list_auth_users.description: Permission: `auth_user.read` — checked in the workspace when workspace_id is given, globally otherwise. Without workspace_id: every account, filtered by search/role_id/exclude_role_id/is_active/is_superuser (`exclude_role_id` drops users holding any listed role). With workspace_id and no search: only that workspace's active members, same filters. With workspace_id and search (trimmed; under 3 characters returns an empty page): a caller holding global `auth_user.read` gets the global search; any other caller gets at most 20 `AuthUserLookupRead` items (`id`, `username`, `avatar_url`) whose username contains the search or whose email equals it, other filters ignored.

schema.description: Drop users who hold any of these roles. Repeat the param or comma-separate ids.
schema.title: Exclude Role Id

rpc.identity.rbac.list_oauth_connections.description: Permission: global `auth_user.read`. Returns all OAuth connections (admin), optionally filtered by search and provider.

rpc.identity.rbac.list_permissions.description: Permission: `permission.read` — checked in the workspace when workspace_id is given, globally otherwise. Returns RBAC permissions, optionally filtered by workspace_id.

rpc.identity.rbac.list_roles.description: Permission: `role.read` — workspace `role.read` with a global `role.read` fallback when workspace_id is given, global `role.read` otherwise. Returns RBAC roles, optionally filtered by workspace_id.

rpc.identity.rbac.list_sessions.description: Permission: superuser only. Returns auth-user sessions (admin), filterable by user_id/search and status (active/revoked/expired).

rpc.identity.rbac.list_user_denies.description: Permission: global `auth_user.read`. Returns the permissions explicitly denied to the given user, each with the workspace_id it is scoped to (null = denied everywhere). Denies are a subtractive overlay on the grant-only role catalog: a deny always beats a grant, which is the whole reason the overlay exists.

rpc.identity.rbac.remove_linked_player.description: Permission: global `auth_user.update`. Removes a linked game player from the given auth user (admin) by user_id/player_id; returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.rbac.remove_role.description: Permission: `role.update` in the role's own scope (a workspace role needs the workspace grant, no global fallback). Removes a role from a user and invalidates the RBAC cache; returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.rbac.remove_user_deny.description: Permission: global `auth_user.update`. Lifts one deny and returns the user's remaining deny list, restoring whatever the user's roles grant. The scope must match exactly: with no workspace_id query param this removes only the global deny, never a workspace-scoped one for the same permission (and vice versa). Idempotent, and busts the RBAC cache.

rpc.identity.rbac.update_role.description: Permission: `role.update` in the role's own scope (a workspace role needs the workspace grant, no global fallback), and a replaced permission set may not exceed the caller's own permissions. Updates the role by role_id and returns it, invalidating the RBAC cache.

rpc.identity.refresh.description: Permission: public; no authentication required — the supplied refresh token is the credential. Rotates a valid refresh token and returns a fresh access+refresh token pair.

rpc.identity.register.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Creates a new auth user from email/password registration and returns the created user (201).

rpc.identity.revoke_api_key.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` on the key's own workspace, which must be active (a global `team.create` grant or superuser also passes), not restricted to the key's owner. Revokes the active user's API key by id; returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.revoke_session.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — the session is resolved under the caller's own id. Revokes one of the active user's sessions by session id; returns 204 No Content (400 on an invalid session id).

rpc.identity.service_token.description: Permission: public; authenticated by the service `client_id`/`client_secret` in the body, not by any user credential. Exchanges service client credentials (client_id + client_secret) for a signed service access token.

rpc.identity.set_password.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user; self-service — the current password must be supplied when one is already set (400 when missing, 401 when wrong); setting the first password needs a session that signed in within the last 10 minutes, else 403 `reauth_required`. Sets or changes the active user's password and signs out every other session; returns 204 No Content.

rpc.identity.sso_exchange.description: Permission: public; no bearer authentication required. Redemption of the single-use, short-lived Redis ticket minted by an OAuth callback on a workspace custom domain, returning the session access+refresh token pair. It exists so the callback can hand a session back to the tenant origin without ever putting tokens in a redirect URL. Called by the custom domain's own frontend route, never by the apex, and the ticket plus the owt_xdomain_guard cookie value together are the credential. The ticket is burned before the guard is checked, so replay -- like an expired, unknown or guard-mismatched ticket -- fails closed with an indistinguishable 400.

rpc.identity.update_api_key.description: Permission: workspace `team.create` on the key's own workspace, which must be active (a global `team.create` grant or superuser also passes), not restricted to the key's owner. Updates the named API key (by id) for the active user and returns the updated record.

rpc.identity.update_me.description: Permission: authenticated (active) user, session bearer only; self-service. Applies a partial profile update to the active user and returns the updated user. Changing `username` is refused when the caller carries an `account.rename` deny, and with 400 when another account already holds that name (compared case-insensitively).

rpc.identity.validate_service_token.description: Permission: public; no caller authentication — the submitted service token is itself the credential being introspected. Validates a service JWT and returns the service token payload; 401 if the service token is missing or invalid.

rpc.identity.validate_token.description: Permission: public; no caller authentication — the submitted token is itself the credential being introspected. Validates a bearer access token or API key and returns the RBAC token payload (user, permissions); 401 if not authenticated.

rpc.stats.ach.calculate.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.update` in the payload's `workspace_id`. Runs the achievement condition-tree engine over one discipline of a workspace (the required `discipline` must be enabled for it; optionally seeding that discipline's built-in rules first and scoping the run to given slugs) and returns the slugs actually evaluated, rejecting unknown slugs and a missing workspace_id with 400. Metered: over quota the call answers 429 with `code=rate_limited` and the exceeded limit in `details.limit_name`.

rpc.stats.ach.calculate_tournament.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.update` in the tournament's workspace. Runs the achievement engine for a single tournament — the workspace is taken from the tournament unless an explicitly matching workspace_id is supplied — and returns the tournament id plus the slugs evaluated, 404ing on an unknown tournament and 422 when the required `discipline` is not the tournament's. Metered: over quota the call answers 429 with `code=rate_limited` and the exceeded limit in `details.limit_name`.

rpc.stats.ach.condition_types.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.read`. Returns the catalog of achievement condition-tree leaf types the required `discipline` (query) can evaluate, with their grain; a discipline with no conditions returns an empty list.

rpc.stats.ach.create.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.create`. Creates a workspace achievement rule in the explicit `discipline` after validating its condition tree, its `entity_id` character and enforcing slug uniqueness (409 when the slug belongs to a rule of any discipline). The discipline is immutable afterwards; the retired `hero_id` is rejected.

rpc.stats.ach.delete.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.delete`. Deletes a workspace achievement rule and returns no content, 404ing when the rule does not exist in that workspace.

rpc.stats.ach.evaluate.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.update`. Triggers a manual achievement evaluation run for the required `discipline`: explicit rule ids must be that discipline's rules, absent ids select its enabled rules, an empty list selects none; the optional tournament must belong to the workspace and discipline.

rpc.stats.ach.export.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.read`. Returns a portable v2 JSON export payload (`discipline` + `entity_id` per rule) of a workspace's achievement rules of the required `discipline`. Metered: over quota the call answers 429 with `code=rate_limited` and the exceeded limit in `details.limit_name`.

rpc.stats.ach.get.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.read`. Returns a single achievement rule scoped to the workspace.

rpc.stats.ach.import.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.create` in the target workspace, plus membership of (or superuser over) the source workspace when one is named. Imports portable v2 achievement rules (each names its discipline) into a workspace and returns the import result. The whole batch is validated before any write: v1/`hero_id`, an unknown or foreign character, a disabled discipline or an invalid tree reject it (400/422), a slug owned by a rule of another discipline is a 409. Metered: over quota the call answers 429 with `code=rate_limited` and the exceeded limit in `details.limit_name`.

rpc.stats.ach.lib_import.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.create` in the target workspace, plus membership of (or superuser over) the source workspace. Imports selected achievement rules of the required `discipline` from a source workspace's library into the target workspace, warning on missing slugs; the same all-or-nothing validation as a portable import applies. Metered: over quota the call answers 429 with `code=rate_limited` and the exceeded limit in `details.limit_name`.

rpc.stats.ach.lib_list.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.read` in the target workspace, plus membership of (or superuser over) the source workspace. Lists the source workspace's achievement rules of the required `discipline` available for library import.

rpc.stats.ach.lib_workspaces.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.read`. Lists other workspaces (visible to the caller) that have achievement rules of the required `discipline` available to import as a library.

rpc.stats.ach.list.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.read`. Pages a workspace's achievement rules with search, category, and enabled filters: every game's, or only the optional `discipline`'s (422 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown code). Each rule names its own `discipline`.

rpc.stats.ach.override_create.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.update`. Creates a manual achievement override (grant or revoke) for a user on a rule, stamped with the granting actor; a tournament or match it names must belong to the rule's workspace and discipline and agree with each other.

rpc.stats.ach.override_delete.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.update`. Deletes a manual achievement override scoped to the workspace.

rpc.stats.ach.overrides_list.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.read`. Lists manual grant/revoke achievement overrides of the required `discipline` for a workspace.

rpc.stats.ach.reset.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.update`. Hard-resets one discipline of a workspace by reseeding its rules and clearing that discipline's evaluation results, returning the new run. Other disciplines' rules, results and overrides are untouched.

rpc.stats.ach.rule_users.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.read`. Returns a paginated, sortable list of users who earned a rule's achievement with counts and first-qualified timestamps.

rpc.stats.ach.runs.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.read`. Returns the 50 most recent achievement evaluation runs for a workspace.

rpc.stats.ach.seed.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.create`. Seeds the required `discipline`'s built-in achievement rules into a workspace and returns seeded/removed counts; other disciplines' rules are never touched, a same-slug rule of another discipline is a 409 and a discipline with no catalog is a 422, both before any write.

rpc.stats.ach.test.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.update`. Dry-runs a rule's condition tree (in the rule's own discipline) against an optional tournament of that discipline and returns the qualifying count plus a sample of results.

rpc.stats.ach.update.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.update`. Updates an achievement rule, revalidating and bumping its version on condition-tree change and re-running evaluation. Omitted fields are unchanged, `entity_id: null` clears the character link, an explicit `{}` tree is an empty tree; `discipline` and the retired `hero_id` are rejected.

rpc.stats.ach.validate.description: Permission: workspace `achievement.read`. Validates an achievement condition tree against the required `discipline` and returns errors plus the inferred grain.

rpc.stats.achievements.get.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a single achievement rule by id (with its `discipline`/`entity_id`; `entities=entity` expands the character), 404 if not found. Pooled numbers use the rule's own discipline.

rpc.stats.achievements.list.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a paginated, sortable list of achievements optionally filtered by workspace. Each rule carries its `discipline` and `entity_id`; `entities=entity` expands the linked character. The cross-workspace view lists one rule per (discipline, slug) and divides earners by that discipline's players.

rpc.stats.achievements.user.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it. Returns a player's earned (and optionally locked) achievements, scoped by tournament or without-tournament and workspace, and optionally to one game's rules (`discipline`; unknown code 404 discipline_not_installed); rejects combining tournament_id with without_tournament=true. `tournaments` and `matches` (where each was earned) are filled only when `entities` names them; otherwise they are empty and not read.

schema.description: Installed discipline code: only that game's rules (earned and locked)

rpc.stats.achievements.users.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a paginated list of players who earned a given achievement.

rpc.stats.catalog.sync.description: Permission: superuser only. Starts a background sync of the discipline module's catalog source (named in the snapshot's `source`) into catalog.entity, mirroring images to S3, and returns its first snapshot (`status: running`) at once. Existing rows keep their name and attrs; an existing parent is kept; a missing one is filled from the source; nothing is deleted. Stages run in order: `source`, then the discipline's kinds `mode`, `map`, `character`; a kind counts the images it actually downloads (`done`/`total`) and reports the rows it created, committing on its own. Every change is published whole as `catalog_sync.progress` on the caller's `user:{id}:catalog-sync` topic (non-durable). A failed sync is `status: failed` with `error.code` `catalog_source_unavailable` (the source timed out, is unreachable or answered an error), the code of the module's refusal (e.g. `catalog_conflict`), `interrupted` or `internal_error`; the stage it died in is `failed`, finished stages stay `done`. 404 for a discipline without a sync; 409 `catalog_sync_running` while a sync of the same discipline runs.

rpc.stats.catalog.sync_status.description: Permission: superuser only. The discipline's last catalog sync snapshot, the same body `catalog_sync.progress` carries; `null` when nothing ran in the last 15 minutes, or when a running sync stopped reporting for 5 minutes (its worker died). 404 for a discipline without a sync.

rpc.stats.impact.recompute_baselines.description: Permission: superuser. Rebuilds the native Overwatch baselines used for MVP-impact scoring (`stats.stat_baseline`) for the active formula version, aggregating a mean/standard deviation per (role id, rank bucket, stat code) from whole-match player facts across workspaces. Returns the row count and formula version. Each run atomically replaces that discipline/version's rows and aborts rather than wiping them when aggregation yields nothing. Repeated runs are safe but scan the historical facts and clear the 10-minute baseline cache.

rpc.stats.ingest.bind.description: Permission: workspace `log.update` in the job's workspace. Binds an `awaiting_link` (or `failed`) job's stored document or raw source to `encounter_game_id` with the operator's complete `teams` map (`document team key -> encounter.team id`, a bijection onto the game's participating teams; a participant contradicting the chosen team is refused, zero overlap is allowed) and publishes it in the same transaction, returning the committed job. The client never sends the document. When the target game already has an observation `expected_revision` is required (`0` = none, `n` = replace exactly revision `n`) and is compared again under the final lock: 409 `stale_revision` / `expected_revision_required`. A `done` job is replayed only by retry with `reparse=true`; a busy job answers 409 `ingest_busy`. Refusals roll back and leave the job as it was: 404 `binding_target_not_found`, 409 `binding_mismatch` / `identity_conflict`, 422 `invalid_team_map`.
rpc.stats.ingest.bind.summary: Bind an unlinked ingest job to a game

rpc.stats.ingest.game_observation.description: Permission: workspace `log.read` in the game's workspace (404 `binding_target_not_found` for an unknown game). Returns the target game's authoritative current observation `{encounter_game_id, match_id, revision, ingest_job_id, is_historical}`; an unoccupied game answers `match_id`/`ingest_job_id` null and `revision` 0. `is_historical` marks an observation without a job or from a historical import, which no bind or reparse can replace. `revision` is what a bind's `expected_revision` must equal.

rpc.stats.ingest.get.description: Permission: same workspace API key and `stats.ingest` scope as submit. Returns the job's actual status, attempts, timestamps, structured error `{code,message,issues}` and, only while the job is still the current evidence of a match, its binding `{encounter_game_id,match_id,revision}`. A job of another workspace is indistinguishable from an absent one (404 `ingest_job_not_found`).

rpc.stats.ingest.submit.description: Permission: a workspace API key whose `stats.ingest` scope is backed by the owner's effective `stats.ingest` permission; sessions, service tokens and owner privilege alone are refused (403 `api_key_required` / `scope_required`). The request body is the bare `owt.match/1` document (Content-Type `application/json`, up to 25 MiB); the workspace is always the key's own. Idempotent per `(source.kind, source.external_id)` when an external id is present, otherwise per the SHA-256 of the exact request bytes: the same bytes return the existing job, changed bytes or discipline under one external id answer 409 `idempotency_conflict`. Answers 202 with the job while it is `pending`/`processing`, and 200 with the actual job when it already finished (`done`, `awaiting_link`, `failed`; a failed duplicate is never retried implicitly). A structurally valid document whose codes do not resolve is persisted as a failed job with diagnostics and answers 422 with `ingest_job_id`; malformed JSON answers 400, a non-JSON content type 415, an oversized body 413.

rpc.stats.logs.history.description: Permission: `log.read` in the workspace named by the scope argument — `workspace_id`, else the tournament's, else the encounter's workspace — or global `log.read` when no scope argument is given. Lists match-log processing records filtered by tournament, encounter or workspace, plus optional status and free-text search, with pagination.

rpc.stats.logs.process_tournament.description: Permission: workspace `log.update` in the tournament's workspace. Enqueues reprocessing of all stored match logs for a tournament and returns an ack message — the work itself runs asynchronously on the log queue — 404ing on an unknown tournament. Metered: over quota the call answers 429 with `code=rate_limited` and the exceeded limit in `details.limit_name`.

rpc.stats.logs.queue_status.description: Permission: global `log.read`. Returns per-status counts of match-log processing records.

rpc.stats.logs.retry.description: Permission: workspace `log.update` in the record's workspace. Resets a failed or awaiting-link log record to pending, re-enqueues it for processing and returns the updated record (with its structured `error`, current `observation_revision`/`is_current_provenance` and, for an awaiting-link record, the document `teams` a bind map is keyed by), 404ing when the record does not exist. A `done` record is never replayed implicitly: 409 `reparse_required`; send `reparse=true` with the `expected_revision` the operator saw to replace its observations directly (409 `stale_revision` when another revision was written, 409 `stale_binding` once the job is no longer the game's current evidence). An optional `encounter_id` first attaches the log to that encounter of the record's tournament (404 unknown encounter, 400 another tournament's, 409 on a processed record), which is how an `encounter_ambiguous` failure is resolved.

rpc.stats.logs.stats.description: Permission: `log.read` in the workspace named by the scope argument — `workspace_id`, else the tournament's, else the encounter's workspace — or global `log.read` when no scope argument is given. Returns scope-wide processing counts per status, average completed duration and the newest record timestamp for a tournament, encounter or workspace.

rpc.stats.logs.upload.description: Permission: workspace `log.create` in the tournament's workspace. Multipart (base64) upload of one or more log files for a tournament, storing each to S3 and enqueueing processing, with per-file errors collected. Metered: over quota the call answers 429 with `code=rate_limited` and the exceeded limit in `details.limit_name`.

rpc.stats.rank.collect.description: Permission: workspace `rank.update` when `workspace_id` is given (only that workspace's players' accounts are touched), otherwise global `rank.update`. Enqueues a native rank-collection run for a user or specific linked game accounts and returns the enqueued count. `discipline` query parameter names the game (default `overwatch`); 404 `rank_collection_unsupported` for a game that collects no ranks.

rpc.stats.rank.fetch_log.description: Permission: workspace `rank.read` when `workspace_id` is given (rows are then scoped to the game accounts of that workspace's players), otherwise global `rank.read`. Lists native rank-collection fetch-log entries filtered by status, source and cursor. `discipline` query parameter names the game (default `overwatch`); 404 `rank_collection_unsupported` for a game that collects no ranks.

rpc.stats.rank.game_account_history.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns one game account's rank time series (`discipline` names the game, default `overwatch`) with granularity, date range, platform and role filters; League series are per queue. `discipline` query parameter names the game (default `overwatch`); 404 `rank_collection_unsupported` for a game that collects no ranks.

rpc.stats.rank.reenable_disabled.description: Permission: workspace `rank.update` when `workspace_id` is given (only that workspace's players' accounts are requeued), otherwise global `rank.update`. Requeues game accounts that were auto-disabled by a transient upstream outage (status disabled -> pending, failure counter reset), spreading them across the collection interval; optionally limited to accounts that previously succeeded. Returns the re-enabled count. `discipline` query parameter names the game (default `overwatch`); 404 `rank_collection_unsupported` for a game that collects no ranks.

rpc.stats.rank.stats.description: Permission: workspace `rank.read` when `workspace_id` is given (aggregates are then scoped to the game accounts of that workspace's players), otherwise global `rank.read`. Aggregated native rank-collection health: account state counts by status and priority tier, snapshot coverage over 24h/7d, last successful capture, last-24h fetch-outcome mix with error rate, upstream circuit state, and the active config. `discipline` query parameter names the game (default `overwatch`); 404 `rank_collection_unsupported` for a game that collects no ranks.

rpc.stats.rank.user_collection.description: Permission: workspace `rank.read` when `workspace_id` is given (empty unless the player is a member of that workspace), otherwise global `rank.read`. Returns the native rank-collection status for each of a user's game accounts. `discipline` query parameter names the game (default `overwatch`); 404 `rank_collection_unsupported` for a game that collects no ranks.

rpc.stats.rank.user_current.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a user's current collected native ranks for the requested platform. `discipline` query parameter names the game (default `overwatch`); 404 `rank_collection_unsupported` for a game that collects no ranks.

rpc.stats.rank.user_history.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a user's collected native rank time series with configurable granularity, date range, platform and role filters. `discipline` query parameter names the game (default `overwatch`); 404 `rank_collection_unsupported` for a game that collects no ranks.

rpc.stats.settings.get.description: Permission: superuser. Returns a single global setting by key.

rpc.stats.settings.list.description: Permission: superuser. Returns all global key/value settings.

rpc.stats.settings.upsert.description: Permission: superuser. Creates or updates a global setting by key, stamping the updating user.

rpc.stats.statistics.champion.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns paginated, sortable players ranked by tournaments won, across every game or only the optional `discipline` (404 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown code), optionally workspace-scoped.

schema.description: Installed discipline code; absent or "all": every game

rpc.stats.statistics.character_leaderboa.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it. Returns a paginated player leaderboard for one character of the path discipline, resolved against the workspace context and its division grid. In a scoped read a row's `div` is a number on the workspace grid named by its `division_grid_version_id`, returned once in `division_grids`; with `workspace_id=all` it is the canonical number on the game's native ladder (`null` for a game without one), `division_grid_version_id` is `null` and `division_grids` empty. 404 when the id is not a character of that discipline.

rpc.stats.statistics.character_playtime.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it. Returns one discipline's paginated character playtime shares (fractions of the returned set, not seconds), optionally scoped to a user, tournament and workspace. 404 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown game.

rpc.stats.statistics.maps.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns the path discipline's maps (404 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown game) grouped by the mode each game was played in (the game's or parsed map's own mode, not the map's catalog parent, so one map can sit under several modes; games without a mode in a last null bucket), optionally workspace-scoped, most played first. A game is one of a completed series of a public, non-league tournament: the series' confirmed games with a map when it has any, else its parsed maps, so nothing counts twice. `share` is a map's games over its mode's; `avg_duration_s` averages the parsed maps of that map and mode (null when none).

rpc.stats.statistics.players.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns every player with at least one public, non-league tournament (substitute entries excluded), across every game or only the optional `discipline` (404 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown code), optionally workspace-scoped: titles, tournaments, maps won/lost, map win rate (null without maps) and `low_sample` (three tournaments or fewer). `sort` = `titles` (default) | `tournaments` | `maps_won` | `winrate` (only players above the low-sample threshold), `order` = `desc` (default) | `asc`. `rank` is the competition rank (1, 2, 2, 4) over the whole population; the optional case-insensitive name search `query` filters the page without renumbering it, and `total` counts the filtered rows. Ties: win rate desc (null last), then name.

schema.description: Installed discipline code; absent or "all": every game

rpc.stats.statistics.records.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns the all-time records of public, non-league tournaments (mixes never count), optionally workspace-scoped, in a fixed order; a record with no data is omitted. Always: `win_streak` (most consecutive series won by a player's team), `biggest_upset` (series won by the roster with the lower average SR, largest gap relative to the loser's), `underdog_champion` (champion with the lowest roster SR rank within its own tournament: `value` = rank, `of_total` = rated teams) and `closest_final` (a finished tournament's final with the highest closeness). With a `discipline` (404 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown code) also the parsed-log records the game has: the highest single-map player `hero_damage`, `healing`, `eliminations`, `damage_blocked` and `solo_kills`, `most_mvps` (maps at impact rank 1) and `longest_map`.

schema.description: Installed discipline code; absent or "all": every game

rpc.stats.statistics.tournament_player_s.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it (404 too for an unknown tournament). Returns every player's tournament average and rank for `performance` (MVP placement), `kda`, `eliminations`, `deaths`, `assists`, `hero_damage_dealt` and `damage_delta` — the same values and ranks as the per-stat tournament leaderboard, pivoted by player (`player_id` is the user id); a player carries only the stats they have data for. Rank 1 is best: Deaths and the MVP placement rank ascending. `total_players` is the largest ranked population across those stats.

rpc.stats.statistics.winrate.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns paginated, sortable players ranked by win rate (players with more than three tournaments), across every game or only the optional `discipline` (404 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown code), optionally workspace-scoped.

schema.description: Installed discipline code; absent or "all": every game

rpc.stats.subscription.check_log.description: Permission: workspace `subscription.read` when `workspace_id` is given (rows are then scoped to that workspace), otherwise global `subscription.read`. Lists append-only subscription check-log entries (the collection history) filtered by state, source, provider, auth user and cursor.

rpc.stats.subscription.collect.description: Permission: workspace `subscription.update` when `workspace_id` is given (the re-check is then limited to that workspace), otherwise global `subscription.update`. Runs a live subscription re-check for one player (optionally limited to specific providers) or sweeps every open tournament that requires a subscription, and returns the number of checks performed.

rpc.stats.subscription.stats.description: Permission: workspace `subscription.read` when `workspace_id` is given (aggregates are then scoped to that workspace), otherwise global `subscription.read`. Aggregated subscription-collection health: entitlement counts by state and provider, distinct-user check coverage over 24h/7d, last successful check, last-24h check-outcome mix with error rate, the number of open tournaments enforcing a subscription, and the active config.

rpc.stats.subscription.user_collection.description: Permission: workspace `subscription.read` when `workspace_id` is given (only that workspace's entitlement is returned), otherwise global `subscription.read`. Returns the current subscription entitlement per workspace and provider for one player.

rpc.stats.users.characters.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it. Returns a player's paginated per-character stats in the required `discipline` for the requested stat names, optionally scoped to a tournament and workspace; rejects invalid stat values with 422. Each row also carries the player's scoped map record on the character (`games`/`win`/`loss`/`draw`; a draw is a game, not a win), every player's discipline-wide `win_rate_all` (unscoped, like `avg_10_all`) and the player's career-best game (`record`) in the stat the character's class is judged by.

schema.description: Installed discipline code

rpc.stats.users.compare.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it. Returns a head-to-head comparison between the given user and others, resolved against the `workspace_id` workspace's division grid and tournaments, or across every workspace with `workspace_id=all` (the default), where `div_min`/`div_max` are canonical numbers on the game's native ladder (a 422 `division_grid_required` for a game without one).

schema.description: Installed discipline code

rpc.stats.users.compare_characters.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it. Returns a per-character head-to-head comparison for the given user against others in the required `discipline`, resolved against the `workspace_id` workspace's division grid and tournaments, or across every workspace with `workspace_id=all` (the default; `div_min`/`div_max` then on the game's native ladder, a 422 `division_grid_required` without one). A character or map id of another game is a 404; a `stats` code the game does not declare as a character stat is a 422 `stat_not_declared`.

schema.description: Installed discipline code

rpc.stats.users.draft_card.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns the draft room's player card for a user in the required `discipline`: career record, per-role and per-character map records, MVP maps and the last five tournaments, scoped to the workspace.

schema.description: Installed discipline code

rpc.stats.users.encounters.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a player's paginated encounters — every game's, or only the optional `discipline`'s (404 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown code), each naming its own `discipline` — filterable by result, stage, MVP (`mvp1` needs `discipline`, else 422), log availability, and opponent. Expansions are opt-in through `entities` (repeatable): `tournament`, `stage`, `stage_item`, `teams`, `teams.players` (implies `teams`; `user_team_id` is resolved from the rosters, else null) and `matches` (`matches.map` is the same: a match always carries its `map` and its own `mode`, null when none). An entity not requested is null/empty and not read. Each match carries the viewer's facts and `member_totals` limited to the stats the game's match renderer ranks the viewer against.

schema.description: Installed discipline code; absent or "all": every game

rpc.stats.users.get_profile.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a player's profile resolved against the workspace context. With `discipline` it is that game's profile (its tournaments, roles and characters on that game's division grid) and `games` is empty. Without it the header aggregates span every game, `roles`/`character_statistics` are empty, `most_played_character` is null, and `games` lists one summary per game played (`discipline`, that game's `roles` without their grid version, `tournaments_count`, `tournaments_won`), most tournaments first, ties in installed order. Every `tournaments[]` entry carries its `discipline`; only `roles[]` carry a `division_grid_version`.

schema.description: Installed discipline code; absent or "all": every game

rpc.stats.users.maps.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it. Returns a player's paginated, sortable per-map record (win/loss/draw/winrate), optionally workspace-scoped. `mode_id` counts only the matches played in that mode (the match's own mode, not the map's catalog parent).

schema.description: Installed discipline code

rpc.stats.users.maps_summary.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it. Returns aggregate totals for a player's per-map record, optionally workspace-scoped; `mode_id` filters by the match's own mode as in the per-map list.

schema.description: Installed discipline code

rpc.stats.users.matches_summary.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns aggregate match totals for a player, optionally workspace-scoped.

schema.description: Installed discipline code

rpc.stats.users.overview.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a paginated, workspace-normalized player overview table built from the workspace grid. `workspace_id=all` reads across every workspace instead: divisions (the `divisions` filter and every role's `division`) are then canonical numbers on the game's native ladder, each rank resolved on its own tournament's grid first; `division_grid_version_id` is `null`, `division_grids` is empty, and for a game without a native ladder `division` is `null` and `divisions` is a 422 `division_grid_required`. A missing `workspace_id` is a 400. The optional `discipline` narrows every aggregate to one game; without it the aggregates span every game, `roles` and `top_characters` are empty and `role`/`divisions` are a 422 (`<param> requires discipline`). Every row lists the games the player played in `disciplines`.

schema.description: Installed discipline code; absent or "all": every game

rpc.stats.users.overview_catalog.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns the A-Z player catalog for the players-overview table from the workspace grid, or across every workspace with `workspace_id=all` (native-ladder divisions, as in the overview). Without the optional `discipline` the cards span every game with empty `roles`/`top_characters`; every card lists its `disciplines`; `role`/`divisions` are then a 422.

schema.description: Installed discipline code; absent or "all": every game

rpc.stats.users.overview_stats.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns aggregate statistics for the players-overview table computed against the workspace grid, or across every workspace with `workspace_id=all` (`division_counts` then on the game's native ladder: empty for a game without one, where `divisions` is a 422 `division_grid_required`). Without the optional `discipline` the counts span every game and `role_counts`, `flex_count`, `flex_declared_count` and `division_counts` are empty; `role`/`divisions` are then a 422.

schema.description: Installed discipline code; absent or "all": every game

rpc.stats.users.teammates.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns a player's paginated, sortable best teammates by winrate and shared tournaments, optionally workspace-scoped.

schema.description: Installed discipline code

rpc.stats.users.tournament.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it. Returns a player's participation and stats for one tournament, resolved against that tournament's division grid.

rpc.stats.users.tournament_encounters.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it. Returns a player's encounters (with per-match stats) within one tournament — the lazy detail behind the Tournaments-tab dossier, fetched only for the tournament currently open in the UI. Each match carries its `map` and its own `mode` (null when none), the viewer's facts, and `member_totals` limited to the stats the game's match renderer ranks the viewer against.

rpc.stats.users.tournament_leaderboard.description: Permission: public; no authentication required, though a hidden tournament 404s unless the optional identity may view it. Returns every player in a tournament ranked by a single stat — the full ranked list behind a user's per-stat rank/total on the tournament-stats page. Inverse stats like Deaths rank ascending. The `stat` must be one of the ranked tournament stats.

rpc.stats.users.tournaments.description: Permission: public; no authentication required. Returns the tournaments a player participated in — every game's, or only the optional `discipline`'s (404 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown code) — scoped to the workspace context and grid, as `results`; each row names its own `discipline` and the `division_grid_version_id` its divisions are tiers of, and `division_grid_versions` carries each of those versions once (ordered by id). A roster player's `characters` are references (`id`, `slug`, `name`, `image_path`).

schema.description: Installed discipline code; absent or "all": every game

rpc.stream.encounter_vods.description: Permission: public; no authentication required (identity is optional and only used for visibility). The tournament POV VOD list narrowed to one encounter: only VODs that show it, each with only that encounter's chapters, ordered by team name, player name and broadcast start, so both teams' perspectives of the match sit side by side. An unknown encounter answers 404, as does one whose tournament is hidden from the viewer; a mix encounter, which belongs to no tournament, answers an empty list.

rpc.stream.health.description: Permission: global `stream.read`. Outcome of the last Twitch live-status poll tick next to the config that produced it: status, when it ran, how many tournaments and channels it covered, how many channels were live, and Twitch's remaining rate-limit budget. Exists because the tick swallows every Helix failure by design so an outage cannot kill the scheduler — without this a poller rejected by Twitch is indistinguishable from a working one. A null status means no tick has been recorded yet, which is not the same as a recorded failure. The grant is global rather than workspace-scoped because there is one poller for the whole platform, so the numbers carry no workspace dimension and a workspace-scoped grant is not enough.

rpc.stream.repoll.description: Permission: workspace `stream.update` on the workspace that owns the tournament. Clears the live-status poll cursor so the next scheduler heartbeat polls immediately (202 Accepted — no poll runs inline). The call is recorded in the audit log. Metered: it consumes quota against the caller's workspace/API-key limits and answers 429 `quota_exceeded` with a `Retry-After` header once they are spent, because the extra Helix traffic it triggers comes out of the 800-points/min app bucket shared with OAuth sign-ins.

schema.description: Workspace the stream.update permission is checked against; must own the tournament.

rpc.stream.ticks.description: Permission: global `stream.read`. The recorded outcome of each of the last 200 Twitch live-status poll ticks, newest first: status, when it ran, tournaments and channels covered, live channels and Twitch's remaining rate-limit budget. Shows when polling started failing and whether it recovered, where the health read only names the latest tick. A disabled poller records no ticks.

rpc.stream.tournament_streams.description: Permission: public; no authentication required (identity is optional and only used for visibility). Returns the tournament's stream block: official broadcast links from its typed links (included whether or not they are on air) and the participant channels that are live right now. A hidden tournament answers 404 for an ineligible viewer. Twitch channels report live true/false; YouTube and other hosts report live null, meaning there is no live detection for them rather than offline. A participant entry carries the player behind the channel together with the team they play for in this tournament; that team is null until rosters are drafted, and the player itself is null on an official broadcast, which belongs to the organizer rather than to any participant.

rpc.stream.tournament_vods.description: Permission: public; no authentication required (identity is optional and only used for visibility). Returns the past Twitch broadcasts (VODs) of the tournament's participants' own POV streams, newest first, each with its chapters: the matches of the streamer's team that the broadcast shows and how many seconds into the VOD each starts, the tournament's stream delay already applied. A map chapter starts at the match log's own time, else at the time in the log's file name (the host PC's clock, its UTC offset chosen from the pre-game room and the reported results), else at the moment the pre-game room finished that map's bans. An encounter with no map timed gets one series chapter, from the pre-game room's opening or the organizer's start; a VOD with no chapter is not listed. Only broadcasts the poller saw live are known, a VOD Twitch no longer has is omitted, and a player who no longer consents to being broadcast disappears from past broadcasts too. Official casts are not included. A hidden tournament answers 404 for an ineligible viewer.

rpc.tournament.admin.create#player_sub_r.description: Permission: workspace `player.create`. Creates a custom player sub-role.

rpc.tournament.admin.create#stage.description: Permission: workspace `stage.create`. Creates a stage under a tournament.

rpc.tournament.admin.create#stage_item.description: Permission: workspace `stage.create`. Creates a stage item under a stage.

rpc.tournament.admin.create#stage_item_i.description: Permission: workspace `stage.create`. Creates a stage item input under a stage item. A `source_stage_item_id` that does not exist or belongs to another tournament is 400.

rpc.tournament.admin.create#tournament.description: Permission: workspace `tournament.create`. Creates a tournament. A generated slug never takes one that a tournament holds or a slug redirect still serves.

rpc.tournament.admin.create#tournament_l.description: Permission: workspace `tournament_link.create`. Attaches one typed external link (Discord, stream, VOD, bracket, rules, other) to a tournament; Rejects a duplicate kind+url pair with 409. The tournament's public overview refreshes at once.

rpc.tournament.admin.delete#encounter.description: Permission: workspace `match.delete`. Deletes an encounter by id (204 no body).

rpc.tournament.admin.delete#player.description: Permission: workspace `player.delete`. Deletes a player by id (204 no body).

rpc.tournament.admin.delete#player_sub_r.description: Permission: workspace `player.delete`. Deactivates a player sub-role by id (204 no body).

rpc.tournament.admin.delete#stage.description: Permission: workspace `stage.delete`. Deletes a stage by id (204 no body).

rpc.tournament.admin.delete#stage_item.description: Permission: workspace `stage.delete`. Deletes a stage item (group/bracket lane) by id, along with its own encounters and standings (204 no body).

rpc.tournament.admin.delete#stage_item_i.description: Permission: workspace `stage.delete`. Deletes a stage item input (team slot) by id (204 no body).

rpc.tournament.admin.delete#standing.description: Permission: workspace `standing.delete`. Deletes a standing by id (204 no body).

rpc.tournament.admin.delete#team.description: Permission: workspace `team.delete`. Deletes a team by id (204 no body).

rpc.tournament.admin.delete#tournament.description: Permission: workspace `tournament.delete`. Deletes a tournament by id (204 no body).

rpc.tournament.admin.delete#tournament_l.description: Permission: workspace `tournament_link.delete`. Deactivates a tournament link by id (204 no body, soft delete via is_active). The tournament's public overview refreshes at once.

rpc.tournament.admin.get#stage.description: Permission: workspace `stage.read`. Returns one stage by id.

rpc.tournament.admin.get#team.description: Permission: workspace `team.read`. Returns one team by id for admin editing.

rpc.tournament.admin.get#tournament.description: Permission: workspace `tournament.read`. Returns one tournament by id for admin editing.

rpc.tournament.admin.list#player_sub_rol.description: Permission: workspace `player.read`. Requires workspace_id; lists only that workspace's child roles — every installed game's, or only the optional `discipline`'s (422 `discipline_not_installed` for an unknown code) — optionally filtered by parent role (which needs `discipline`, else 422) and including inactive ones. Each row names its own `discipline`.

schema.description: Installed discipline code; absent: every game's sub-roles.

rpc.tournament.admin.list#stage.description: Permission: workspace `stage.read`. Lists all stages of a tournament.

rpc.tournament.admin.list#tournament_lin.description: Permission: workspace `tournament_link.read`. Lists a tournament's links ordered by sort_order then id, optionally only the active ones.

rpc.tournament.admin.update#encounter.description: Permission: workspace `match.result` for the result fields (status, closeness, started_at, ended_at, current_map_index), `match.update` for every other field; a payload mixing both needs both. Updates an encounter by id. The scoreline is not here: it lives on the participations and only `encounter_set_result` writes it. Standings are recomputed only when the status, stage, stage item, round or `best_of` changes; any other edit only refreshes the encounter reads.

rpc.tournament.admin.update#player.description: Permission: workspace `player.update`. Updates a player by id.

rpc.tournament.admin.update#player_sub_r.description: Permission: workspace `player.update`. Updates a player sub-role by id.

rpc.tournament.admin.update#stage.description: Permission: workspace `stage.update`. Updates a stage by id.

rpc.tournament.admin.update#stage_item.description: Permission: workspace `stage.update`. Updates a stage item by id.

rpc.tournament.admin.update#stage_item_i.description: Permission: workspace `stage.update`. Updates a stage item input by id. A `source_stage_item_id` that does not exist or belongs to another tournament is 400.

rpc.tournament.admin.update#standing.description: Permission: workspace `standing.update`. Updates a standing by id. Recomputes update changed rows in place, so a standing keeps its id, but the next recompute still overwrites an edited computed field.

rpc.tournament.admin.update#team.description: Permission: workspace `team.update`. Updates a team by id.

rpc.tournament.admin.update#tournament.description: Permission: workspace `tournament.update`. Updates a tournament by id. Linking a Challonge slug fetches that tournament first: 404 `challonge_not_found` when Challonge does not know it, 503 `challonge_unavailable` when Challonge is unreachable, times out, rate-limits or fails.

rpc.tournament.admin.update#tournament_l.description: Permission: workspace `tournament_link.update`. Updates a tournament link by id; Rejects a duplicate kind+url pair with 409. The tournament's public overview refreshes at once.
